title: “What we are standing for is a right to say no”
content:
For more than a decade, Antonia Burke travelled across Australia listening to First Nations people describe the impacts of government decisions on their lives. Over the years, she heard stories of oppression, injustice and intergenerational trauma. As a First Nations woman from the Yanyuwa and Garrwa people from the Northern Territory, Antonia understands first-hand how government policies can shape lives. That understanding took on new urgency when she saw the extent of offshore oil and gas development across the Arafura and Timor Seas, waters that sustain communities, cultures and marine life across Australia, Timor-Leste, Papua New Guinea and Indonesia. First Nations people in Australia call these waters “Sea Country” –  a source of identity that holds stories and songlines that have guided people for generations.

As Founder and Director of Sea of Nations, Antonia works with First Nations people and coastal communities to hold decision makers accountable for ensuring meaningful consultation and consent before decisions affecting their territories are made. Here, she shares her experience:

title: Tervetuloa Arcana Borealis -näyttelyn ennakkokatselmukseen ke 21.10.
content: Arcana Borealis -ennakkokatselmus medialle järjestetään ke 21.10. alkaen klo 10. Ilmoittauduthan tilaisuuteen etukäteen (ohjeet ja linkki alla). Paikat täytetään ilmoittautumisjärjestyksessä. Näyttelyyn voi tutustua klo 13 asti. Arcana Borealis -näyttely tarkastelee pohjoisen alueen taiteilijanaisten taidetta ja sen yhteyksiä henkisyyteen, luontoon ja näkymättömiin todellisuuksiin 1800-luvulta nykypäivään. Ateneumiin näyttely tuo myös poikkeuksellisen materiaalien ja tekniikoiden runsauden.

title: Matias Mäkynen on aloittanut vanhempainvapaan
content:
SDP:n kansanedustaja Matias Mäkynen on aloittaa tänään vanhempainvapaan. Hän kertoo tiedotteessa pitävänsä vanhempainvapaata täydet 160 päivää.

– Kuten esikoisemme kanssa, jaamme vanhempainvapaat tasan. Vapaiden tasainen jako on mielestäni vähintä, mitä voin isänä tehdä oman hoivavastuuni ottamiseksi.

Mäkynen on jo asetettu kesäkuussa eduskuntavaaliehdokkaaksi Vaasan vaalipiiristä ensi kevään eduskuntavaaleissa.

– Vanhempainvapaalla seuraan politiikkaa ja osallistun yhteiskunnalliseen keskusteluun lapsen ehdoilla. Säädimme eduskunnassa viime vaalikaudella vanhempainvapaauudistuksen, jonka lähtökohta ja tavoite oli vapaiden tasaisempi jako. Isien osuus vapaista onkin lähtenyt hyvään nousuun ja haluan omalta osaltani ja esimerkilläni edistää tätä kehitystä.

Mäkysellä ja hänen vaimollaan Maria Mäkysellä on kaksi lasta.

title: Wikimedia Affiliations Committee Has New Officers and Advisors
content:
The Wikimedia Affiliations Committee (AffCom) has begun a new chapter, with changes to its leadership and the addition of new advisors.

AffCom is the committee that advises the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees on the recognition and continued existence of Wikimedia movement affiliates, including chapters, thematic organisations, and user groups.

Following the latest appointments in July 2026, the officers are: Mari Avetisyan as Chair, Harriet Bayel as Vice-Chair, Johnny Alegre as Secretary, and Robert Jamal as Treasurer.

The four officers bring experience from different parts of the Wikimedia movement and regions of the world. Together with the other voting members, they will support the Committee’s ongoing work on affiliate governance, conflict resolution, and the development of the affiliate ecosystem.

AffCom’s voting members are supported by non-voting advisors, who contribute experience, language skills, institutional knowledge, and governance expertise. Advisors can take part in Committee discussions and subcommittee meetings, offering additional perspectives on the Committee’s work.

title: Aineeton pääoma talouskasvun ja tuottavuuden lähteenä: Katsaus tutkimuskirjallisuuteen ja suuntaviivoja politiikalle
content: Tämä katsaus kokoaa yhteen aineetonta pääomaa käsittelevän tutkimuksen havaintoja. Analysoimme 60 viimeaikaista julkaisua makro-, meso- ja mikrotasolla (erityisesti Suomen, muun Euroopan, Yhdysvaltojen ja Aasian yritysaineistoilla). Katsaus osoittaa aineettomien investointien nousseen globaalisti talouskasvun, kilpailukyvyn ja tuottavuuden keskeiseksi ajuriksi. Kirjallisuudesta nousee esiin kolme yhteiskuntapoliittista teemaa. Ensinnäkin, aineettoman pääoman mittaamista ja tilastointia on kehitettävä, sillä nykyisellään suuri osa investoinneista jää piiloon virallisilta tilastoilta ja yritysten taseilta. Toiseksi, innovaatiopolitiikkaa tulee laajentaa kapeasta tutkimus- ja kehitystoiminnan (t&k) tuesta koko aineettoman pääoman kirjoon – kuten ohjelmistoihin, dataan, organisaatiopääomaan, johtamiseen ja brändeihin – huomioiden näiden väliset täydentävyydet. Kolmanneksi, aineettoman pääoman voimakas skaalautuvuus vaatii sekä kilpailu- ja innovaatiopolitiikan että yritysrahoitusympäristön yhteensovittamista, jotta voidaan samanaikaisesti tarjota kannustimia ja rahoitusta aineettomien investointien tekemiseen sekä ehkäistä haitallista markkinoiden keskittymistä ja tukea tiedon laaja-alaista leviämistä.

title: Aatteiden Venäjä -teos avaa laajasti maan poliittisen ja yhteiskunnallisen ajattelun historiaa ja osoittaa, ettei Venäjä ole muuttumaton
content:
Venäjä ei ole ristiriidaton tai yhtenäinen kokonaisuus. Sanna Turoman, Vesa Oittisen ja Mika Perkiömäen toimittama Aatteiden Venäjä: Ideoiden ja aktivismin historiaa nostaa esille venäläisen poliittisen ja yhteiskunnallisen ajattelun taustat nationalismista ja fasismista anarkismiin ja ympäristöaatteeseen. Viimeisten reilun sadan vuoden aikana Venäjän kehitystä on luonnehtinut radikaali ideologinen heiluriliike, mikä haastaa kuvan ”ikuisesta Venäjästä.”

Venäjän hyökkäys Ukrainaan muutti peruuttamattomasti maailman geopoliittista tasapainoa. Aatteiden Venäjä -teoksessa asiantuntijat taustoittavat hyökkäykseen johtaneita kehityskulkuja ja avaavat uusia, laajoja näkökulmia venäläisen poliittisen ja yhteiskunnallisen ajattelun historiaan. Samalla tarkastellaan vähemmän tunnettuja aate- ja tieteenhistorian ilmiöitä.

title: Missing Lao Critic in Thailand Feared ‘Disappeared’
content:
Three weeks ago, 26-year-old Lao activist Khieo Lapchanh, an asylum seeker in Thailand, vanished in Samut Sakhon province following his shift at the restaurant where he worked.

Khieo’s disappearance in the early hours of September 15 came one day before his first interview with the United Nations refugee agency (UNHCR) in Bangkok. Thai authorities have yet to provide any information regarding his whereabouts.

Khieo had been posting videos critical of the Lao government to his Facebook page, Khiew Channel, which had about 158,000 followers. According to Manushya Foundation, a rights group that supported him, he had faced coordinated harassment, doxxing, and death threats. After Lao officials visited his mother's home in Laos this year on March 31 and April 17 concerning his activities, Khieo stopped posting political content.

Given the threats he faced and the history of enforced disappearances of Lao activists both in Laos and abroad, Thai authorities should urgently locate him.

title: Kiellettyjen kirjojen kirjasto
content:
Esillä on noin 1000 kiellettyä kirjaa. Lisäksi 4000 teosta on kirjaston varastossa.

“Lastenkirjoihin reagoidaan kaikkein useimmin”, kertoo kirjastonhoitaja Jens Zingmark.

Hän on työskennellyt Malmön kiellettyjen kirjojen kirjastossa lähes neljä vuotta, heti avaamisesta lähtien.

“Esimerkiksi Nalle Puh on kielletty Kiinassa, koska hänen väitetään muistuttavan presidentti Xi Jinpingiä.”

Kokoelman uusia lisäyksiä ovat esimerkiksi yli 500 kirjaa, jotka on kielletty Iranissa ja 100 Venäjällä kiellettyä ukrainalaista kirjaa.

“Yritämme aina saada kirjat haltuumme alkuperäiskielellä.”

Kuinka usein kirjasto on saanut moitteita siitä, että jokin kirja ei saisi olla siellä?

“Niin on käynyt vain muutaman kerran. Pääasiassa ne ovat olleet kirjoja, joissa on rasistinen hahmo. Onneksi juuri mitään kokoelman kirjoja ei ole tuhottu. Soraääniä kokoelman kirjoista kuuluu lähinnä sosiaalisessa mediassa.

Zingmarkin mukaan kirjaston työtä helpottaa se, että jo kirjaston nimeen sisältyy oletus, että kokoelmassa on joitakin epämiellyttäviä kirjoja.

Tärkeä asia on kirjaston seinällä oleva valkotaulu, johon asiakas voi jättää muistilapun itseään huolettavasta kirjasta.

title: Arvokas metsä- ja suoalue Halsualla suojellaan OX2:n lahjoituksen avulla
content:
Luonnonperintösäätiö on hankkinut 28 hehtaarin metsätilan Halsualta Keski-Pohjanmaalta. Hankittu kohde sijaitsee suoraan Luonnonperintösäätiön olemassa olevan Virvatulen suojelualueen kaakkoisrajalla ja nostaa suojellun kokonaisuuden pinta-alan 90 hehtaariin.

Alueen hankinnan ja sen tulevan ennallistamisen mahdollisti uusiutuvan energian yhtiö OX2:n lahjoitus, joka liittyy rakenteilla olevan Kanniston tuulipuistohankkeen luonnon monimuotoisuutta tukeviin toimenpiteisiin.Syrjäinen ja osin erämainenkin alue on erityisen tärkeä muun muassa metsäpeuroille, suurpedoille ja maakotkille. Näiden elinolosuhteet paranevat, kun kohteen suot ennallistetaan ja sen luontoarvot turvataan pysyvästi luonnonsuojelulain mukaisella rauhoituksella. Virvatulen suojelualueen merkitystä lisää sen eteläpuolella sijaitseva 3 550 hehtaarin laajuinen Hangasnevan-Säästöpiirinnevan soidensuojelualue.

”Virvatulen suojelualueen laajennus vahvistaa seudun ekologista verkostoa ja tukee luonnon monimuotoisuuden säilymistä. Olemme erittäin iloisia siitä, että OX2 toimii vihreään siirtymän yritysten etujoukoissa ja haluaa olla mukana turvaamassa luonnon monimuotoisuutta konkreettisella tavalla. Toivomme, että alan muut toimijat seuraavat perässä”, toteaa Luonnonperintösäätiön toimitusjohtaja Timo Huhtamäki.

title: Ei bisnestä vaan yhteistä hyvää – Brasiliassa on maailman laajin äidinmaitopankkien verkosto
content:
Kylmää huurua nousee ilmaan, kun Danielle Aparecida da Silva avaa pakastimen oven. Muovihansikkain suojattu käsi kurkottaa kohti kierrekantista purkkia. Sen sisällä on kellertävän valkoista, jäätynyttä nestettä: äidinmaitoa.

”Tämä saapui eilen luovuttajalta”, da Silva kuiskaa kasvomaskinsa takaa. Hän tarkistaa kannessa olevan numeron. Sitten hän laittaa purkin takaisin. Varovasti, kuin kyseessä olisi aarre. Ja tavallaan onkin.

52-vuotias da Silva johtaa Brasilian vanhinta äidinmaitopankkia. Se sijaitsee Rio de Janeirossa Fernandes Figueira -instituutissa, joka on naisten ja lasten terveydenhuoltoon erikoistunut julkinen sairaala.

Kaksi lääkäriä perusti maan ensimmäisen maitopankin tänne vuonna 1943. Rakennuksen sisäänkäynnillä pronssipatsas esittää äidin ja lapsen tiiviissä syleilyssä. Kadun toisella puolella kimaltelee Botafogon ranta: hikoilevia lenkkeilijöitä, kookospähkinöiden myyjiä ja näkymä Sokeritoppavuorelle.

Klikkaa kuvaa ja löydät jutun kaikki kuvat galleriasta.

title: Discover the Lost Horror Series Deemed Too Shocking for BBC Television (1967)
content: High culture and new technology have never been a natural pairing. As our digital era has often underscored, media innovations tend to be adopted earliest to deliver the most puerile, sensation-driven content, with the more respectable stuff benefiting only later. When the BBC was introducing color broadcasting in the mid-nineteen-sixties, for instance, it was used for the likes of Thunderbirds, The Avengers, and The Benny Hill Show, respectable though those programs may now seem compared to what mainstream television would become in later decades. No color production of that period aimed quite as low as the anthology series Late Night Horror — or has since been raised so high in the minds of those who remember it.

content:
Suomen kirjastoseura yhdessä Porvoon kaupunginkirjaston kanssa on mukana Revive!-hankkeessa, jossa selvitetään maaseutualueiden kirjastojen ja paikallisten toimijoiden yhteistyötä sekä luodaan malli, jonka avulla yhteistyötä voidaan kehittää. Hankkeen muut kumppanit ovat Northern Dimension Partnership on Culture (NDPC), Cesisin kunnankirjasto Latviassa sekä Latvian kansalliskirjasto. Lue lisää hankkeesta täältä.

Osana hanketta toteutetaan kysely, jonka tarkoituksena on kartoittaa kirjastojen työntekijöiden kokemuksia, tarpeita ja haasteita yhteistyössä maaseutualueiden paikallisyhteisöjen ja organisaatioiden kanssa.

Kutsumme kyselyyn mukaan kirjastoja, jotka määrittelevät itsensä maaseutukirjastoiksi. Tuloksia hyödynnetään käytännönläheisen yhteistyömallin kehittämisessä. Mallin tavoitteena on auttaa kirjastoja vahvistamaan yhteistyötä paikallisyhteisöjen ja kumppaneiden kanssa.

Kyselyyn vastaaminen kestää noin 20 minuuttia ja siihen vastataan anonyymisti. Kysely on avoinna 16. lokakuuta saakka. Kiitos, että jaat kokemuksesi ja osallistut Revive!-hankkeen kehittämiseen!

title: Visionära samtal i fokus på Kulturpolitisk samling 2026
content:
Den 12 oktober bjuder Svensk Scenkonst och Sveriges Museer in till tredje upplagan av Kulturpolitisk samling, där en rad aktörer i samhället möts kring en aktuell och utvald fråga för kulturlivet. Årets forum är en visionsdag om Sverige som kulturland och framtidens kulturpolitik.

Evenemanget hålls på Kulturhuset Stadsteatern och livesänds i Svensk Scenkonsts och Sveriges Museers Youtubekanaler. 

Årets tema, ”Kulturriket Sverige”, handlar om vilken kulturpolitik Sverige behöver idag och framåt.

– Det behövs en ny och brett förankrad vision om vilket kulturland Sverige ska vara. Vi vill se ett land där konst, kultur och bildning är en självklar del av samhällsbygget och där kulturens kraft tas tillvara för att möta framtidens utmaningar. Med Kulturpolitisk samling vill vi öppna för samtal om hur en ny kulturpolitik kan se ut, säger Mikael Brännvall, vd för Svensk Scenkonst.

Begreppet Kulturriket Sverige ska inte ses som en färdig politisk modell. Målet med dagen är i stället att samla en rad aktörer och tillsammans börja formulera de frågor och den riktning som en ny kulturpolitik behöver ta sin utgångspunkt i.

title: Who owns ‘brain rot’?: inside the international legal drama over a beloved meme
content:
Copyright law in the US only applies to human-made creations, but AI characters like Tung Tung Tung Sahur are challenging that

One of the most beloved characters in an absurdist genre of online video content has become the center of an international legal battle that could determine where human creativity ends and artificial intelligence begins.

Tung Tung Tung Sahur, also known as Triple T, was created in 2025 by an Indonesian teen who goes by the username Noxa, using OpenAI’s image-generation tool. Based on a kentongan – a type of drum used to wake south-east Asian Muslims for their pre-dawn meal during Ramadan – the character is an anthropomorphized version of the instrument with a broad smile and a vacant stare. He sits under the umbrella of “Italian brain rot” internet videos.

title: From overlooked disease to global research priority
content:
Every October, Breast Cancer Awareness Month brings people around the world together under the pink ribbon to raise awareness, encourage early detection, support patients and fund research.

To mark this year’s campaign, COST is publishing a success story about the LOBSTERPOT Action on lobular breast cancer. The aim of this research initiative is to improve the detection, treatment and outcomes for patients.

For years, invasive lobular cancer (ILC) was one of the least understood forms of breast cancer. Despite being the second most common type, research efforts were scattered and coordinated clinical approaches were limited.

To change this, the COST Action Lobular Breast Cancer: Discovery Science, Translational Goals, Clinical Impact (LOBSTERPOT) brought together researchers, clinicians, and patient advocates, establishing one of the world’s leading scientific communities dedicated to this disease. In the process, the network has launched new clinical trials, developed diagnostic guidance that could influence future global standards, and transformed the way ILC is studied and understood.

title: 200+ cultural organisations oppose proposed cuts to Creative Europe
content:
More than 200 cultural organisations across Europe are calling on EU Member States to reverse the proposed cuts to Creative Europe’s annual budget for 2027. An open letter was initiated and coordinated by Culture Action Europe.  

The Council suggests reducing the funding Creative Europe can commit to projects in 2027 by €31.6 million. The proposed cuts would affect every strand: €7.8 million from Culture, €23.2 million from MEDIA and €0.6 million from the Cross-sectoral strand. 

This is the fourth budget year in the current seven-year cycle in which the Council has proposed cuts to Creative Europe. ‘Year after year, we must defend funding for cooperation that the EU says it wants to strengthen,’ the letter states.  

The proposed cuts are at odds with the EU’s own commitments. In June 2026, the Presidents of the Council, Parliament and Commission signed the Joint Declaration ‘Europe for Culture – Culture for Europe’, committing to ensuring the independence of cultural institutions, artistic freedom, and sustainability of the cultural and creative sectors. The 2027 budget is an immediate opportunity to put those commitments into practice.

title: Report on the Arrest of Shahrouz Sadidi in Sabzevar
content:
According to HRANA, Shahrouz Sadidi was arrested by IRGC Intelligence agents in Sabzevar on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Sadidi was transferred to Sabzevar Prison following his arrest and is currently being held in solitary confinement in the prison’s quarantine ward. A one-month temporary detention order has been issued for him.

Shahram Sadidi, his brother, also stated in a published post that a security-related case has been opened against Shahrouz Sadidi at Branch 1 of the Investigation Office of the Sabzevar Prosecutor’s Office, presided over by investigator Golestani. He is facing a charge of “propaganda against the regime.”

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the specific grounds underlying the charge against him.

Shahrouz Sadidi was previously arrested on November 30, 2025, along with his sister, Shokouh Sadidi, by agents of the Sabzevar Ministry of Intelligence. The two were released after several hours of interrogation and after signing a written pledge.

title: Germany’s Unfinished Sovereignty: Is Neutrality Still Possible?
content:
By Wolfgang Bittner*

GÖTTINGEN, Germany | 6 October 2026 (IDN) — Recently, there have been calls for Germany to become neutral,[1] as Stalin had already proposed in 1952. At that time, he offered the other three principal victorious powers of the Second World War negotiations on a peace treaty with Germany. The condition was the neutrality of a future united Germany, except for the eastern territories under Polish administration.

At the same time, the Adenauer government had already decided, in secret negotiations, to rearm and join NATO. The Western Allies rejected the Soviet proposal. Konrad Adenauer also dismissed it as an “unserious diversionary tactic” meant to prevent the Federal Republic of Germany from integrating into the West. In this way, Germany lost an opportunity to pursue a self-determined policy.

title: Three IJ4EU-supported investigations shortlisted for prestigious EU prize
content:
Winners of the 2026 Daphne Caruana Galizia Prize will be announced on October 21 at the European Parliament.

Three investigations supported or seeded by the Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU) programme have been shortlisted for the prestigious 2026 Daphne Caruana Galizia Prize for Journalism.

War Made Sustainable, Sponsored Hate and Inside Europol’s Shadow IT System are among the 10 finalists competing for the European Parliament’s annual award, which recognises outstanding journalism defending European values, including democracy, the rule of law and human rights.

The winner will be announced on October 21, 2026 at the European Parliament in Strasbourg.

The three investigations examine different forms of power and accountability, from the interests shaping European investment policy to the paid amplification of attacks on independent voices and the safeguards governing police access to sensitive information.

Coordinated by Voxeurop, with contributions from El País, IrpiMedia and Mediapart, this investigation traced how investment funds marketed as green or socially responsible channel billions of euros into weapons manufacturers.

title: Valkoposkihanhivahingot ympäristökysymyksenä
content: Valkoposkihanhi (Branta leucopsis) herättää Suomessa paljon keskustelua, sillä lajin kanta on kasvanut voimakkaasti menestyksekkään suojelun ja hanhille suotuisten ympäristötekijöiden ansiosta. Lintujen runsastuminen aiheuttaa merkittäviä taloudellisia ja sosiaalisia haittoja itäsuomalaisilla pelloilla, sillä hanhien muuttomatka kulkee Suomen kautta pohjoiselle jäämerelle ja takaisin Pohjanmeren alueelle. Hanhien aiheuttamia haittoja pyritään ratkaisemaan laajalla toimijajoukolla yhdistämällä eri menetelmiä. Mukana ovat niin viljelijät, kylätoimijat, metsästäjät kuin maatalouden edunvalvojat, yhdistykset ja lainsäätäjät.

title: Montenegro Moves to Seize Vast Real Estate Empire of Fugitive Crime Boss
content:
Authorities in Montenegro might not be able to catch the country's most notorious fugitive crime boss, but they are moving to dismantle his financial empire.

The Special State Prosecutor's Office asked Tuesday the High Court in Podgorica to permanently confiscate a sprawling portfolio of real estate and luxury vehicles it believes is in his or his wife’s possession. While the official statement only identified the targets by their initials, R.Z. and his wife, T.Z., the request appears to be detailing the hidden wealth of the reputed Kavač clan leader Radoje Zvicer and his wife Tamara Zvicer. Local media reports also name the two as the targets of this request.

The timing of this massive forfeiture request is no coincidence. It serves as one of the first major tests of Montenegro's sweeping new "Anti-Mafia Law," passed on September 4. The government hailed the legislation as a "historic step" that has already caused an "earthquake in criminal circles," specifically because it empowers the state to permanently confiscate assets in organized crime cases even before a final judicial verdict is reached.

title: More Than 500 U.S. Citizens Have Been Detained, Including Handcuffed or Held at Gunpoint, in Trump’s Immigration Crackdown
content:
Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets and the erosion of civil rights for immigrants will inevitably result in the erosion of rights for citizens.

Since the start of this Trump administration, we’ve watched those warnings come true.

The Trump administration says none of this is happening.

“DHS is NOT arresting U.S. citizens by mistake.” “There are no ‘indiscriminate’ stops.” Allegations of “racial profiling are disgusting, reckless and categorically FALSE.” “The pattern is NOT of law enforcement using force.” “ICE does not zip tie or restrain children.”

But that is precisely what is happening, and at a far larger scale than previously reported.

We know because we have once again done what the government hasn’t:

We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent holding a citizen during the current administration.

More than 500 cases. That includes:

  • More than a hundred Americans held after agents questioned their citizenship. Nearly all were people of color.
  • At least 70 American children and teens detained, some of whom were handcuffed.

title: Jailed Albanian mayor uses AI avatar to make deepfake speech
content:
TIRANA, Albania — Tirana Mayor Erion Veliaj has caused a stir with a video pledge of free school lunches for all the capital’s children. There’s one problem: Veliaj is currently in prison, and the blue-suited figure making the heartfelt announcement is AI-generated.

In an Instagram post on his official profile labeled as AI-generated, the video likeness of the 46-year-old appears in front of the Albanian and municipal flags, listing his achievements in office while reiterating his promise of free school lunches for the city’s kids. 

“I made another commitment that I will never forget: food in schools,” says the Veliaj clone. “I will keep this promise even from this cell where they have locked me up.”

Veliaj has been in prison in the coastal city of Durres since early 2025 amid investigations over allegations of corruption and financial crimes. He denies any wrongdoing. 

“My hostage situation has been going on for 20 months, and I can only greet you with artificial intelligence,” his avatar says. “I will continue to work even from the cell … I hug you with longing, you and your wonderful children.”

title: A camera combined with AI could help further diagnosis of movement disorders like spinal muscular atrophy in newborns
content:
Detecting impaired motor function as early as possible after birth with the help of a standard camera linked to intelligent systems can help in diagnosing infantile conditions characterised by hypotonia: reduction or loss of active muscle movement. A research team is investigating this approach based on the work carried out on babies with spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), a rare genetic neuromuscular disorder.

In 2019, the drug Zolgensma made headline news as the world’s most expensive treatment. The price of this medicine for spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) has been set at nearly 2 million euros per injection.

And, at the same time, what an extraordinary breakthrough! It promises to provide a definitive cure for a genetic disease that, if survivors do live, leads to extremely severe disabilities in children affected by what is the world’s first hereditary peripheral neurological disorder.

Behind these staggering figures lies an urgent medical situation. For these therapies to be effective, it is essential to identify the condition as early as possible. This is precisely the challenge our team set out to tackle, by using an ordinary camera coupled with artificial intelligence.

title: Miksi kodin netti tuntuu hitaalta, vaikka nopeuden pitäisi olla kunnossa?
content:
Jos kotiin tulee nopea valokuitu ja netti silti takkuilee, syy löytyy usein seinien sisäpuolelta. Suurin osa koetusta pätkimisestä johtuu kodin langattomasta WiFi-verkosta, ei itse nettiyhteydestä. WiFi-signaali heikkenee nopeasti seinien läpi mentäessä ja saattaa ottaa häiriötä naapureiden verkoista tai kodin muista sähkölaitteista.

Jos netti tuntuu hitaalta, käy läpi tämä lista:

Kodin laitteet ja langaton verkko:

  • Sijoita reititin oikein: Älä piilota WiFi-reititintä sähkökaappiin, sohvan taakse tai paksun betoniseinän viereen. Sijoita se keskeiselle paikalle, mielellään hieman lattiatasoa korkeammalle.
  • Käytä kaapelia: Esimerkiksi videopuheluita vaativiin etätöihin käytettävä tietokone tai älytelevisio kannattaa liittää reitittimeen suoraan verkkokaapelilla. Se on varmin tapa estää pätkiminen.
  • Tarkista laitteiston ikä: Vanha reititin ei välttämättä jaksa käsitellä nykyaikaisia nopeuksia. Varmista, että laitteesi on ajan tasalla.
  • Harkitse Mesh-verkkoa: Jos asuntosi on suuri tai monikerroksinen, laadukas Mesh-järjestelmä on paras ratkaisu. Se luo kotiin yhden laajan langattoman verkon, joka kantaa jokaiseen huoneeseen.

A former senior UN food agency official has alleged he was fired last week for his work highlighting hunger in Gaza, and has launched an appeal against his dismissal.

title: Utsjoen julistus on nyt saatavilla neljällä kielellä
Yemen: Huthis Prosecute UN, Civil Society Staff
content:
The Huthi de facto authorities in Yemen have sent at least eight people involved in human rights and humanitarian work for criminal prosecution, for espionage related charges punishable by death, since 18 August 2026, Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch said today. They include two United Nations employees, a UN consultant, and five people who worked with international and local civil society organizations on a range of issues, including health, human rights and humanitarian aid.

The Huthis should immediately halt these prosecutions and immediately and unconditionally release all eight people whose caes were sent for prosecution along with scores of other UN staff and civil society workers the Huthis have arbitrarily detained over the past two years.

The prosecution is the latest escalation in a crackdown by Huthi authorities on civil society in the part of Yemen they control, with successive waves of arrests of Yemenis targeting UN staff and civil society members since 31 May 2024.  The Huthis have arbitrarily detained over 100 such staff and workers, holding them without charge and denying them access to lawyers and their families.

title: Climate Change and Free Knowledge: Workshops for Editing Urgent Issues
content: Together, as a community, and with climate change activists, we held the CC+CL (Climate Change and Open Knowledge) workshops. On Friday, September 11, we came together to explore a topic that is rarely discussed in conjunction: free knowledge and environmental conflicts through actions aimed at climate justice. The virtual session brought together young environmental activists from the Bolivian Platform for Action on Climate Change (PBACC, spanish acronym), who arrived with questions and a strong desire to understand what Wikipedia has to do with the struggles they face every day. We discussed the Wikimedia Foundation and its projects, with a special focus on Wikipedia, that encyclopedia we all use but few of us dare to question or advocate for. We began by debunking some common misconceptions —such as that Wikipedia “isn’t serious” or “anyone can write anything,” among others— and explained how it really works: creating an account, the review mechanisms, and the importance of sources. It was a necessary introduction, designed as a prelude to what would come the following day.

title: Ennuste ei ole vaikutusarvio
content:
Keskustelu datakeskushankkeista on käynyt kuumana sen jälkeen, kun Google ilmoitti rakentavansa neljä datakeskusta Suomeen. Yleisemmin kysymys on siitä, miten suurten yksittäisten hankkeiden tai tapahtumien pitäisi näkyä koko talouden ennusteessa. Keskustelusta on unohtunut se, että ennuste ei ole yksittäisten tapahtumien yhteenlaskemista vaan talouden eri ilmiöiden yhteensovittamista, kirjoittaa Etla-kolumnissaan pääekonomisti Jenni Pääkkönen.

Hakukoneyhtiö Google ei ole avannut datakeskushankkeen vaikutusarviota kovinkaan läpinäkyvästi, vaikka monia oletuksia tai tuloksia siitä onkin kerrottu julkisuuteen. Se ei vielä tee arviosta automaattisesti kelvotonta, vaan kertoo siitä, että hanke sisältää monia yrityssalaisuuksia, joita ei voi julkisesti avata.  

Toisaalta yhtiöllä on varmasti myös intressi nostaa esiin hankkeen positiivisia vaikutuksia, sillä suhtautuminen datakeskushankkeisiin on erityisesti Yhdysvalloissa muuttunut sangen nihkeäksi. Siksi annettuihin tietoihin tulee suhtautua tietyllä varauksella.  

Kaiken huminan keskellä on kuitenkin muistettava, että Google on pörssiyhtiö, eikä siten voi julkisesti satuilla ihan mitä tahansa.

title: Yemen: Houthis Prosecute UN, Civil Society Staff
content:
(Beirut) – The Houthi de facto authorities in Yemen have sent at least eight people involved in human rights and humanitarian work for criminal prosecution, on espionage-related charges punishable by death, since August 18, 2026, Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch said today. They include two United Nations employees, a UN consultant, and five people who worked with international and local civil society organizations on a range of issues, including health, human rights, and humanitarian aid. 

The Houthis should immediately halt these prosecutions and unconditionally release the eight people whose cases were sent to the prosecution, as well as the scores of other UN staff and civil society workers the Houthis have arbitrarily detained over the past two years. 

The prosecution is the latest escalation in a crackdown by Houthi authorities on civil society in the part of Yemen they control, with successive waves of arrests of Yemenis targeting UN staff and civil society members since May 31, 2024. The Houthis have arbitrarily detained over 100 such staff and workers, holding them without charge and denying them access to lawyers and their families.

title: In 1704, Isaac Newton Predicted That the World Will End in 2060
content:
We have become quite used to pronouncements of doom, from scientists predicting the sixth mass extinction due to the measurable effects of climate change, and from religionists declaring the apocalypse due to a surfeit of sin. It’s almost impossible to imagine these two groups of people agreeing on anything other than the ominous portent of their respective messages. But in the early days of the scientific revolution—the days of Shakespeare’s contemporary Francis Bacon, and later 17th century Descartes—it was not at all unusual to find both kinds of reasoning, or unreasoning, in the same person, along with beliefs in magic, divination, astrology, etc.

Yet even in this maelstrom of heterodox thought and practices, Sir Isaac Newton stood out as a particularly odd co-existence of esoteric biblical prophecy, occult beliefs, and a rigid, formal mathematics that not only adhered to the inductive scientific method, but also expanded its potential by applying general axioms to specific cases.

title: Seuran jäsen, hae mukaan työryhmien toimintaan!
content:
Työryhmätoiminta on Kirjastoseuran suola!

Etsimme nyt työryhmiin uusia jäseniä kaudelle 2027–28. Suomen kirjastoseurassa toimii vuonna 2026 kuusi työryhmää. Työryhmiin voit tutustua täällä. Lisätietoja työryhmien toiminnasta saat kunkin ryhmän puheenjohtajalta.

Työryhmiin etsitään jälleen uusia jäseniä. Samalla lomakkeella haetaan sekä työryhmän varsinaiseksi että opiskelijajäseneksi. Huomaathan, että koulutus-ja tutkimustyöryhmän suuren koon vuoksi ryhmään ei valita tällä hakukierroksella täysin uusia edustajia.

Työryhmätoiminta tarjoaa seuran jäsenille mahdollisuuksia verkostoitua, oppia ja kehittää asiantuntijuuttaan. Se tarjoaa vaikuttamiskanavan (suomalaiseen) kirjastotyöhön, auttaa tutustumaan kirjastokenttään valtakunnallisesti ja ryhmässä toimimisesta saa työtodistuksen. Käytännön toimintaan ryhmät saavat apua ja tukea myös seuran toimistolta.

Työryhmän tehtäviä ovat:

  • toimia Kirjastoseuran hallituksen tukena antaen asiantuntija-apua
  • edistää yhdenvertaisuutta ja moninaisuutta kirjastoalalla
  • tukea ammattitaitoa järjestämällä koulutuspäiviä ja ammattitapaamisia sekä tarjoamalla mahdollisuuksia vertaistukeen

title: Asumisen tarpeet moninaistuvat – Asuntotuotannon on uudistuttava
content:
Rakennustietosäätiön uusi tietosynteesi kokoaa tutkimustiedon ja alan asiantuntijoiden näkemykset siitä, miten suomalaisen asuntotuotannon tulisi vastata väestön, kotitalouksien ja elämäntapojen muutoksiin.

Väestö ikääntyy, yksinasuminen yleistyy ja maahanmuutto lisää asumistarpeiden kirjoa ja työn sekä arjen tavat muuttuvat. Etä- ja hybridityö tekevät kodista yhä useammin myös työtilan. Monipaikkaisuus hajauttaa arkea useaan paikkaan ja eri elämänvaiheet kasvattavat tarvetta asunnoille, jotka mukautuvat erilaisiin käyttötapoihin. Myös kotitalouksien maksukyky asettaa asumiselle reunaehtoja.

Asuntokanta muuttuu huomattavasti hitaammin kuin väestö ja elämäntavat, joten tämän päivän asuntotuotannon ratkaisut määrittävät asumisen mahdollisuuksia vuosikymmeniksi. Jos tuotetut asunnot ja asuinympäristöt eivät vastaa kotitalouksien arjen ja tilan tarpeita tai taloudellisiin mahdollisuuksiin, seurauksena voi olla heikko kysyntä, vajaakäyttö, kalliit muutostyöt tai rakennusten elinkaaren ennenaikainen päättyminen.

title: Vallankumouksellista kehitystä Steve Jobsin malliin
content:
Tuulikki Närhinsalo

”Nosta katseesi. Katso ympärillesi. Ole läsnä”. Tällainen teksti ilmestyi parisen vuotta sitten Kansallisoopperan tekstityslaitteeseen luettavaksi ennen esityksen alkua. Sillä haluttaneen viestittää, että nyt on aika lakata tuijottamasta kännykän ruutua ja rauhoittua kokemaan se yhteisöllisyyden tunne, jonka oopperan tai baletin seuraaminen tarjoaa. Lähes hätkähdin, kun Mason Batesin oopperan The (R)evolution of Steve Jobs viimeinen repliikki ja sen kaikkein tärkein sanoma, jonka Jobsin vaimo laulaa miehensä kauniisti rakennetussa muistotilaisuudessa, on tekstilaitteeseen suomennettuna ”Nostakaa katseenne, katsokaa pois laitteistanne”. Miten tärkeä viesti meille kaikille!

Mahdollisimman nopealle teknologian kehittämiselle elämänsä pyhittänyt Steve Jobs, jonka epäterveellisen hektinen ja itsekeskeinen elämäntapa tuhosi naissuhteita, työyhteisöjä ja lopulta hänen terveytensä, haki ja sai helpotusta elämänsä kiemuroihin buddhalaisuudesta. Tämä teema on oopperassa vahvasti mukana. Elontaipaleensa loppumetreillä Jobs pohtii tekemiään valintoja ja niiden seurauksia kriittisesti munkkiystävänsä kanssa.

title: Lawmakers Introduce Multiple Laws to Curb Flock After 404 Media Coverage
content:
Multiple Democrat, Republican, and Independent lawmakers have introduced new pieces of legislation that, if passed, would dramatically curb federal agencies’ access to Flock cameras, with the lawmakers referencing reporting by 404 Media in their explanations for why the legislation is needed.

On Friday Senator Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.), Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-N.Y.), and Senator Jeff Merkley (D-Ore.) announced the Ban Flock Act, which would prohibit federal agencies from using automatic license plate readers (ALPRs) and block federal funding from state and local governments that use the cameras. It would also let Americans sue the federal government for violation of their rights through ALPRs.

title: Reza Mostafaei Arrested and Transferred to Dehdasht Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Reza Mostafaei was arrested on Saturday, October 3, 2026.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Mostafaei had previously been summoned to Branch 6 of the Prosecutor’s Office of Kohgiluyeh County on a charge of “propaganda against the regime.” Yesterday, after appearing at the branch, he was arrested due to his inability to post bail set at eight billion tomans and was transferred to Dehdasht Prison.

An informed source close to his family confirmed the news to HRANA and said that the assistant prosecutor handling the case, Mr. Paydar, made demeaning remarks toward Mr. Mostafaei during the session in reference to his mobility disability and physical condition. According to the source, the assistant prosecutor also questioned him about writing slogans and his support for the families of those killed during the protests.

The source further stated that Reza Mostafaei suffers from spinal problems and a physical disability, and that his transfer to prison has heightened concerns among his family and those close to him regarding his health.

title: Our Reporter Spent 10 Weeks Gambling on DraftKings. Here Are 5 Things He Learned.
content:
Online gambling has surged in the U.S. since the Supreme Court allowed states to legalize sports betting in 2018, prompting public health concerns about gambling addiction and calls for stricter consumer protections. Online sportsbooks such as DraftKings and FanDuel have touted “responsible gaming” features as evidence that they are taking appropriate steps to protect consumers from spiraling out of control.

Reporter Jake Pearson put these safeguards to the test. Bankrolled by ProPublica, he mimicked the betting patterns of a problem gambler for 10 weeks, consulting a panel of addiction specialists, recovering gambling addicts and professional sports bettors for advice.

He found that the safety features were overpowered by the app’s product design and promotions that pushed him to continue gambling.

Pearson detailed his entire journey, which you can read here. Here are five takeaways from his investigation.

title: Nobel physics prize awarded for discovery of ‘ghostly messengers’ from the cosmos
content:
The 2026 Nobel prize for physics has been awarded to Francis Halzen for his discovery of high energy neutrino particles from space.

The Nobel committee said Halzen has made “decisive contributions” to the discovery of “neutrinos of astrophysical origin” with IceCube, an experiment installed under ice at the South Pole.

Ellen Moons, secretary general of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, referred to these neutrinos as “ghostly messengers”. This references the fact the particles have nearly no mass and pass through solid objects with hardly any interaction. In fact, billions of neutrinos pass through any given person on Earth every second.

Most of these neutrinos are emitted by the Sun. However, high energy neutrinos coming from elsewhere in the cosmos also reach our planet. These neutrinos are about a billion times rarer than those that stream out from the Sun.

They originate from diverse sources, such as black holes located at the hearts of distant galaxies that accelerate particles to extreme energies.

title: Olli Rehnin varoitus: ”Tällaisia vaikutuksia voi ilmaantua hiipien ja huomaamatta”
content:
Euroalue on kestänyt iskuja, mutta kasvu on silti vaimeaa. Lisäksi Lähi-idän tilanne hidastaa maailmantalouden kasvua ja aiheuttaa epävarmuutta tulevasta inflaatiokehityksestä, arvioi Suomen Pankki.

Euroopan keskuspankin (EKP) neuvosto on nostanut tänä vuonna kahdesti ohjauskorkoja. Nostojen puolesta ovat puhuneet inflaationäkymät ja niihin liittyvät riskit.

- Nykyisen korostuneen epävarmuuden vallitessa on erityisen perusteltua, ettei EKP sitoudu etukäteen mihinkään tiettyyn korkotasoon, vaan tekee päätöksensä koroista kokous kerrallaan ja hyödyntää uusimpia tietoja, Suomen Pankin pääjohtaja ja EKP:n neuvoston jäsen Olli Rehn sanoo tiedotteessa.

Rehn sanoo, ettei EKP:n neuvosto ole toistaiseksi havainnut inflaation levinneen energian ulkopuolisiin hintoihin tai paikkoihin.

- Valppautta kuitenkin vaaditaan, sillä tällaisia vaikutuksia voi ilmaantua hiipien ja huomaamatta. Mitä kauemmin Lähi-idän konflikti on päällä, sitä suuremmaksi kasvaa riski, että energiahintojen nousu leviää, Rehn jatkaa.

SUOMEN PANKIN arvion mukaan maailmantaloudessa on parhaillaan kaksi erilaista vastavoimaa, Iranin sota ja tekoälybuumi.

title: Wiki Loves Arbërësh: an expedition to document the Albanian diaspora heritage in Sicily
content:
At the end of September 2026, a small crew of Wikipedia volunteers in Sicily, Italy, went to Piana degli Albanesi, a town near Palermo. Our goal: document and highlight the cultural heritage of this community on the Wikimedia projects.

Piana degli Albanesi (Hora e Arbëreshëvet) has a very particular culture, as the most important centre of the Arbëresh community of Sicily, that preserved many traditions from the Albanian diaspora since the 15th century: from the Byzantine-Catholic churches to traditional costumes, and the Arbëresh language, classified as endangered by UNESCO.

Staying in Piana for a weekend was a wonderful experience: we received a warm welcome from the town’s residents, who went out of their way to help us visit and document as many places as possible in just a few days, and who shared the unique aspects of their culture with us with passion and pride.

On top of talking to people to get a grasp of the history and challenges of the Arbëresh community, we wanted to gather as much content as possible to release under a free license on the Wikimedia projects, so it could be available to everyone online and contribute to preserving the Arbëresh living heritage.

title: Tunisia: Power, Water Shortages Endanger Rights
content:
(Beirut) – Tunisian authorities failed to ensure an adequate supply of electricity and water during two months of extreme summer heat, undermining the right to health and endangering lives, Human Rights Watch said today. President Kais Saied blamed the shortages on sabotage, yet authorities failed to provide transparent information and instead cracked down on protesters. 

Rolling power outages left hospitals and water pumping stations without electricity and households without running water, interrupted critical medical procedures, and contributed to a nationwide shortage of drinking water. Doctors and human rights groups have reported a rise in heat-related hospitalizations and deaths exacerbated by the cuts, including among detainees.

title: New Research: Disadvantaged Neighbourhoods Have Stronger Social Cohesion Than Other Residential Areas
content:
Although disadvantaged neighbourhoods have become a highly charged political issue, residents’ own experiences have not been systematically mapped. A Nordic study shows that residents feel just as strong a sense of national belonging as other population groups, but experience stigma associated with their home address.

The research project “The Future of Diverse and Disadvantaged Neighborhoods in the Nordic Welfare States – The Voices of Residents” sought to give residents of disadvantaged neighbourhoods a voice in public debate. Researchers from four Nordic universities interviewed people in six stigmatized urban districts in Sweden, Denmark and Finland. These neighbourhoods are characterized by a high proportion of residents with low socioeconomic status and a high proportion of immigrants.

title: Ofcom investigates Meta over Instagram Instants safety checks
content:
Watchdog examining whether company carried out adequate risk assessment as required by Online Safety Act

Mark Zuckerberg’s Meta is under investigation for a potential breach of the UK’s digital safety laws after launching a Snapchat-style feature on Instagram.

The communications watchdog, Ofcom, is investigating whether the $1.9tn (£1.4tn) company infringed the Online Safety Act (OSA) by failing to carry out adequate checks on whether its Instagram Instants product could show illegal content or be accessed by children.

title: Hallituksen esitys heikentäisi T&K-rahoituksen uskottavuutta
content:
Suomalaisen tutkimuksen ja innovaatioiden menestys perustuu pitkäjänteisiin investointeihin ja ennakoitavaan toimintaympäristöön. Tutkimuksen ja teknologisen kehityksen vaikuttavuus ei synny vuosittaisten talousennusteiden aikajänteellä, vaan vuosien ja usein vuosikymmenten määrätietoisen työn tuloksena. Siksi T&K-rahoituksen tavoitteista ja niiden toteuttamista ohjaavista periaatteista on pidettävä kiinni myös taloudellisesti haastavina aikoina.

Hallitus on antanut esityksen eduskunnalle laiksi valtion tutkimus- ja kehittämistoiminnan rahoituksesta vuosina 2024–2030 annetun lain 2 §:n muuttamisesta.

Unifi ei kannata hallituksen esitystä. Erityisen ongelmallisena Unifi pitää esitystä, jonka mukaan valtion T&K-rahoitukseen voitaisiin jatkossa lukea myös sellaista innovaatiotoiminnan rahoitusta, joka ei täytä tutkimus- ja kehittämistoiminnan määritelmää. title: Opintoseteliä käytetään Helsingin yliopistossa eniten oikeustieteen ja farmasian opintoihin
content:
Initial figures for the study voucher pilot indicate that many people are sticking to their goals despite not securing a student place in the spring. 

The study voucher was introduced on 5 August 2026 in a nationwide pilot where young people without a student place can complete open university studies worth 30 credits free of charge. 

Most vouchers have been used for studies required for degrees in law, pharmacy and the educational sciences, followed by psychology and the social sciences. 

Every year, university applicant numbers for the most popular fields exceed their intake many times over. The figures indicate that study vouchers are used precisely for studies in fields that are difficult to enter through the regular route. In other words, not securing a student place in the spring does not mean that you have to abandon your plan. 

“The study voucher scheme is well underway. It’s great that so many have taken advantage of it. Later in the autumn, awareness is expected to increase further,” says Head of Services Jenni Krapu from Education Services.

title: Edellä-foorumi sai kiitosta keskusteluista – järjestäjä pohtii tapahtumalle jatkoa
content:
Johanna Kohvakka

Edellä – Vihreän aatteen foorumi järjestettiin Helsingissä 18.–19. syyskuuta. Tapahtuman jälkeen tunnelmat ovat järjestäjä Sivistysliitto Vision pääsihteerin Katja Alvoitun mukaan erittäin myönteiset.

"Päällimmäinen ja tärkein fiilis on se, että konsepti kantoi. Periaatteellisella tasolla liikkuvat keskustelut tutkijoiden, poliitikkojen, tietokirjailijoiden ja aktivistien kanssa olivat ihan valtavan inspiroivia", Alvoittu sanoo.

Hänen mukaansa juuri tämänkaltaisen ajatustenvaihdon luonteva paikka on sivistysliiton tapahtumassa.

"Tämän tyyliset keskustelut on jotain, mikä sopii erinomaisen hyvin sivistysliiton tehtäväksi. Teemme sellaista sivistystyötä, mitä vaaleihin ja ohjelmatyöhön keskittyvä puoluekoneisto ei tee."

Edellä-foorumissa käsiteltiin vihreään aatteeseen, yhteiskunnan tulevaisuuteen, talouteen ja demokratiaan liittyviä kysymyksiä useista näkökulmista. Tavoitteena oli tarjota tilaa keskusteluille, jotka eivät rajoitu päivänpolitiikkaan tai yksittäisiin poliittisiin ohjelmakysymyksiin.

Myös tapahtumaan osallistuneiden palautteessa nousi esiin erityisesti keskustelujen merkitys.

title: January 2026 Protests: Mani Partani Sentenced to Eight Years in Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Mani Partani has been sentenced to imprisonment.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Partani’s sentence was issued last week by Branch 1 of the Revolutionary Court of Bojnurd and subsequently communicated to him. Under the ruling, he was sentenced to a total of eight years in prison on charges of “propaganda against the regime,” “insulting the Supreme Leader,” and “assembly and collusion.”

He is currently being held in Bojnurd Prison, where the principle of separation of prisoners based on the nature of their offenses is not being observed, and he is housed alongside prisoners convicted of non-political offenses.

Mr. Partani was arrested by security forces in Bojnurd during the January 2026 protests.

title: October 7: a Palestinian-Israeli memoir seeks to break the cycle of violence
content:
Since the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, the world has witnessed unimaginable, almost constant violence in Gaza and the West Bank. But people’s understanding of these events is not universal – each person is exposed to a particular set of narratives surrounding history, victimhood and trauma.

The vast majority of news reports, social media posts, videos, and books that have covered the events since October 7, 2023 can be defined as what I call “conflict media”, which reproduces the divisions of the conflict it describes, perpetuating it to the point where the media itself becomes a weapon in an information war.

As a scholar of the Middle East, I have rarely – though not never – encountered conflict media’s opposite, which I call “resolution media”.

The most famous works of resolution media have emerged after a conflict ends, and highlight the universal suffering of war. Wilfred Owen’s first world war poem Dulce et Decorum Est, for instance, is still widely quoted to expose “the old Lie” that it is “sweet and fitting” to die for one’s country.

title: Viranomainen pysäytti Googlen työmaat Muhoksella ja Kajaanissa
content:
Lupa- ja valvontavirasto LVV on kehottanut Tuike Finlandia keskeyttämään datakeskushankkeiden valmistelutoimet Muhoksella ja Kajaanissa.

Tuike Finland on Googlen tytäryhtiö. Viraston mukaan muun muassa kaikki alueiden metsänraivaus- ja maansiirtotyöt pitää pysäyttää välittömästi, viimeistään 23. lokakuuta mennessä.

Suunnittelutyötä saa kuitenkin jatkaa.

Virasto epäilee, että rakennuttaja on myllännyt aluetta liian laajasti ennen kun sen ympäristövaikutusten arviointi on valmistunut.

DATAKESKUSTEN työmaita epäiltiin jo syyskuussa julkisuudessa muun muassa alueiden puuston laittomista hakkuista.

LVV varaa Tuike Finlandille mahdollisuuden lausua mielipiteensä ja antaa kirjallisen selityksensä kehotuksen ja mahdollisten jatkotoimenpiteiden vuoksi.

Selityksessä yhtiötä pyydetään ottamaan kantaa erityisesti siihen, aikooko yhtiö noudattaa kehotusta.

Virasto voi ottaa käyttöön hallintopakkotoimia, mikäli yhtiö ei toimi oikein.

title: WikiRempah Overcomes Challenges in Tidore for Training and Documentation of Historic Sites
content:
After Wikimedia Indonesia organized WikiLatih for students in Tidore in 2019, the WikiRempah team aimed to continue its efforts to spread knowledge. The initiative, led by Ana Ainina, Supardi Sahabu, and Sofi Solihah, was funded by Rapid Fund Wikimedia Foundation.

Finding partners in Tidore presented a unique challenge for us. There is a time difference of about two hours between the team’s location and Tidore, so we had to adjust our communication process accordingly. In the early stages, we searched for potential partners via machine learning and reached out one by one to local literacy communities that might be interested in collaborating.

We also leveraged our existing inter-community networks and even expanded our search through connections within government circles. However, differences in age and communication styles required us to adjust our approach.

title: Sri Lanka: Counterterrorism Bill Retains Abusive Powers
content:
(Brussels) – The Sri Lankan government’s latest attempt to replace its abusive Prevention of Terrorism Act (PTA) retains numerous provisions that have enabled serious human rights violations, Human Rights Watch said today.

The proposed Protection of the State from Terrorism Bill (PSTB), which will be sent to Parliament on October 6, 2026, includes an overbroad definition of terrorism, inadequate judicial oversight, sweeping powers of search and arrest for the armed forces, and executive authority to curtail freedom of speech, assembly, association, and movement. These provisions neither meet the benchmarks set out by United Nations human rights experts, nor comply with human rights obligations and commitments that Sri Lanka made to the European Union under the Generalized System of Preferences (GSP+), which links trade benefits to human rights conditions.

title: Helsinki Seriös: PHANTASM 18.10.2026
content:
"Moniäänistä eli polyfonista musiikkia voi kuunnella nauttien sen soinnillisesta kauneudesta mutta kannattaa myös kiinnittää huomiota siihen, miten kukin ääni on rohkeasti itsenäinen samalla kun yhdistyy muihin ääniin", kirjoittaa Phantasm-yhtyeen perustaja Laurence Dreyfus tulevan Helsinki Seriös -konsertin ohjelmasta.

Vuonna 1994 perustettu Phantasm on vakiinnuttanut asemansa yhtenä maailman parhaista renessanssimusiikin tulkitsijoista. Kansainväliseen suosioon yhtyeen nosti Henry Purcellin teoksia sisältänyt esikoislevy, joka voitti Gramophone-palkinnon vuoden 1997 parhaana barokin instrumentaaliäänitteenä. Ympäri maailmaa konserttisarjoissa ja festivaaleilla esiintyvän Phantasmin Gramophone-palkintojen määrä on noussut sittemmin kolmeen, monien muiden tunnustusten lisäksi.

Radioasemien soittolistoilla Phantasm on menestynyt niin ikään. William Lawesin tanssisarjakokoelman The Royal Consort (2015) sisältävä äänite nousi viikon levyksi useilla radioasemilla ympäri Eurooppaa ja Yhdysvaltoja. Lisäksi se pysytteli korkeilla sijoituksilla Ison-Britannian klassisen musiikin listoilla useiden kuukausien ajan.

title: Turun AMK:n haastattelututkimus: Teknologia ei korvaa myyjää, harkinta ratkaisee kaupat
content:
Digitaaliset teknologiat ja kanavat, kuten tekoäly ja sosiaalinen media, ovat muuttaneet yritysten välistä myyntiä nopeasti. Tuoreen tutkimuksen mukaan ratkaisevinta ovat työkalujen tarkoituksenmukainen käyttö ja myyjän kyky valita asiakastilanteeseen sopivin toimintatapa.

Turun ammattikorkeakoulun Myynti ja B2B-liiketoiminta -tutkimusryhmän toteuttamassa tutkimuksessa haastateltiin 74 suomalaista kaupallisen alan ammattilaista useilta toimialoilta, kuten ICT-, pankki-, teollisuus- ja energia-aloilta. Vastausten perusteella tärkeintä on valita kussakin tilanteessa toimivimmat työkalut, mutta teknologia ei yksin määritä myynnin onnistumista.

Kokonaistilanteen arviointi on myyjän keskeinen taito

Tutkimusryhmän asiantuntijat Timo Holopainen ja Arto Kuuluvainen kehittivät haastattelututkimuksen pohjalta käsitteen relationaalinen orkestrointikyvykkyys, joka kuvaa myyjän kykyä lukea asiakastilannetta ja yhdistää siinä tarvittavat teknologiat, toimijat ja kohtaamistavat.

– Kyse on käytännössä harkintakyvystä. Myyjän pitää tunnistaa, mitä asiakas juuri siinä hetkessä tarvitsee, mikä tapa palvelee häntä parhaiten ja mihin tarkoitukseen kutakin työkalua kannattaa käyttää, he kiteyttävät.

title: EVA: S2-opetuksesta luovuttava – maahanmuuttajaoppilaiden kielituki yhteisiin luokkiin
content:
Maahanmuuttajataustaisten oppilaiden erillisopetusta pitää vähentää tuntuvasti ja suomen kielen oppimista siirtää yhteisiin luokkiin, esitetään Elinkeinoelämän valtuuskunta EVAn analyysissä. Ehdotuksessa luovutaan S2-opetuksesta ja muiden kuin kotimaisten kielten oman äidinkielen opetuksesta.

Taustalla on tieto kansainvälisesti poikkeuksellisen suurista eroista maahanmuuttajataustaisten ja kantaväestön oppimiseroissa Suomessa. PISA-tuloksissa juopa säilyy suurena, vaikka oppilaiden sosioekonominen asema ja kotikieli huomioidaan. Aiheesta kirjoitti hiljattain myös Verden kolumnisti Eva Tawasoli.

EVAn mukaan ongelma ei poistu myöskään Suomessa syntyneiden toisen polven maahanmuuttajien kohdalla.

Analyysin laatineen ekonomisti Sanna Kurrosen mukaan yksi mahdollinen syy on se, että maahanmuuttajataustaiset oppilaat laajalti eriytetään muista oppilaista. Suomessa oppilas voi opiskella erillisissä ryhmissä valmistavassa opetuksessa, suomi toisena kielenä eli S2-opetuksessa, oman äidinkielen opetuksessa sekä oman uskonnon opetuksessa.

title: AutoCiteWikidata :Making Automatic Citations Connected with Wikidata
content:
Adding a citation to Wikipedia has become much easier over the years. VisualEditor’s automatic citation tool can often turn an ISBN, DOI, or web address into a formatted reference in just a few clicks, largely thanks to its integration with Zotero.

But there is another source of bibliographic information that Wikimedia editors increasingly have at their disposal: Wikidata.

Could Wikidata make automatic citations more connected, reusable, and easier to maintain?

AutoCiteWikidata is an attempt to explore that possibility.

When we find a useful source online, we often copy its URL into the citation tool. This works well when the web page contains good bibliographic metadata. But sometimes the result describes the web page rather than the work itself.

A scanned book on Internet Archive, for example, is still a book. A research paper accessed through a publisher’s website is still a journal article.

Ideally, the citation should identify the book or article, including its author, title, publisher or journal, publication date, volume, pages, and other available identifiers—not merely the website where we found it.

This is where Wikidata can help.

title: Misuse of AI is brands’ top reputational threat, new survey says
content:
The findings come after warnings from tech leaders that AI placed in the wrong hands could trigger larger threats such as nuclear war or bioweaponry destruction

Misusing artificial intelligence (AI) is the top threat to companies’ reputations – more so than being accused of putting children in the way of mental, emotional or physical harm and issues exposed by the US-Israel war on Iran, among other brand risks, according to a new survey of more than 150 public affairs leaders.

Those findings in the new edition of the quarterly Reputation Risk Index, released on Tuesday, came on the heels of other perhaps more dire warnings from leading tech figures that AI in the wrong hands could precipitate existential threats on a mass scale such as nuclear war or destruction by bioweaponry.

title: Transatlantic Biotech Spurs Cancer Breakthroughs
content:
The advances are astounding. A personalized cancer vaccine developed with messenger RNA (mRNA) technology extends the survival of melanoma patients. It trains patients’ immune systems to recognize and attack unique mutated proteins found only on their tumor cells. Another new mRNA drug, Daraxonrasib, doubles the life expectancy of pancreatic cancer patients.

These breakthroughs result from longstanding cooperation between US and European researchers and firms.

Start with the basic research. In 2005, Hungarian Katalin Karikó and American Drew Weissman at the University of Pennsylvania showed that modifying the nucleoside building blocks of synthetic mRNA could reduce unwanted inflammatory responses while improving protein production. Their work helped make therapeutic mRNA viable and later earned them the 2023 Nobel Prize.

The technology then moved across the Atlantic.

Germany’s BioNTech pursued mRNA and individualized cancer immunotherapies long before the COVID-19 pandemic. When the pandemic arrived, BioNTech partnered with US pharma giant Pfizer to develop and distribute the COVID vaccine.

title: A copyright advent calendar – making copyright literacy a little more playful
content:
Erica Levi is the he copyright lead at Lanchester Library, Coventry University. Her team specialises in embedding Open Educational Resources in teaching at the university.  She advises and train colleagues on copyright and licences. Since copyright still seems like a dreary topic for most colleagues, she set herself a mission to develop online educational games. She tell us….

When Halloween decorations appear in shops before we have quite accepted that summer is over, and Christmas merchandise follows closely behind, my thoughts inevitably turn to how to bring copyright into it. Perhaps that is an occupational hazard?

But there is a serious idea behind it. Over the years, I have become increasingly interested in how we can make copyright education feel less daunting and more inviting. Copyright is important, but that doesn’t mean learning about it always has to involve lengthy guidance, formal training, or lots of text. Sometimes a quiz, a game or a slightly silly seasonal scenario can start a conversation just as effectively.

Certain times of year also give us a ready-made excuse to try something different. I like to latch onto calendar events, really. 

Why make copyright seasonal?

title: What could the EU Artists’ Charter look like? Read the sector blueprint
content:
Imagine your ideal working life in culture. How are you paid? Do you have the space and freedom to create? What support can you count on if you fall ill? What happens to your rights if you work across borders? 

Now try to document this perfect condition and think about who should do what to make it happen. 

That’s what we at Culture Action Europe have been working on over the past five months with our members. Together, we wrote the paper ‘Towards the EU Artists’ Charter: A Sector Blueprint.’ It is our contribution to the forthcoming official document of the European Commission, the EU Artists’ Charter, that we expect mid-2027 and that should outline fundamental principles, guidance, and commitments for fair working conditions in the cultural and creative sectors. 

The Action Group on Working Conditions developed the Charter Blueprint, co-facilitated by Culture Action Europe and Platform ACCT. The process brought together 40 representatives of cultural organisations and European networks from our membership.

title: Hands Off Our Census: Comments due November 2
content:
The US Census, conducted once every 10 years, has an importance that is difficult to overstate. The goal of every census is to “count everyone once, only once, and in the right place". While most people probably associate the Census with apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives, that is not its only purpose.  The data are used for the following decade to make decisions on school funding, disaster preparedness, public health infrastructure, roads and traffic patterns, and nearly every other facet of daily life for American residents. 

There are three monumental changes currently proposed to how the census would operate:

  • Many residents would no longer be counted, including work-visa holders, international students, and other non-citizen residents.
  • People may be counted in the wrong place, using tax records as addresses instead of where folks actually live, who may be in a different location due to moving, college, service members, and others.
  • For the first time since 1790, race and ethnicity questions would be prohibited, which would mean that the US, at state, federal, and local levels, would not have reliable race/ethnicity data.

title: Meet Issa Amro: Palestinian Human Rights Advocate Attacked by Settlers, Detained by Israeli Army
content:
We speak with Palestinian human rights defender Issa Amro after he was detained at an Israeli military base for seven hours on Friday. Amro, the founder of the Hebron-based group Youth Against Settlements, was helping a Palestinian family that he says had been attacked by armed Israeli settlers at their farmhouse outside Hebron in the occupied West Bank. Amro says when Israeli soldiers arrived, they ignored the settlers and instead targeted the Palestinians, including him. Amro tells Democracy Now! that soldiers handcuffed and blindfolded him before transporting him to the base in the back of a military vehicle. He was freed after an international outcry over his arrest.

“What happened to me is happening to many Palestinian families and many Palestinian human rights defenders and many Palestinian journalists,” says Amro. “It’s not the first time. It’s not the last time. We have to keep working to make occupation [and] apartheid costly and make this kind of human rights violation costly for the offenders.”

title: Hakkerit veivät elävien ja kuolleiden tanskalaisten henkilötietoja
content:
Tanskassa hakkerit ovat päässeet käsiksi 8,8 miljoonan tanskalaisen henkilökohtaisiin tietoihin, kertovat maan viranomaiset.

Tanskassa on noin kuusi miljoonaa asukasta, mutta vääriin käsiin ovat joutuneet myös miljoonien kuolleiden tanskalaisten tiedot.

Hakkerit ovat viranomaisten mukaan saaneet käsiinsä ainakin nimiä, osoitteita sekä henkilötunnuksia.

Tanskan käyttämä kymmenen merkin CPR-tunnus muodostuu Suomen tapaan syntymäajasta sekä neljän merkin yksilöllisestä tunnuksesta. Järjestelmässä on rekisteröitynä noin 11 miljoonaa ihmistä, joiden joukossa on Tanskassa asuvien lisäksi myös kuolleita ja ulkomaille muuttaneita tanskalaisia.

CPR-rekisteri sai perjantai-iltana tiedon tietoturvaloukkauksesta, joka viranomaisten mukaan tapahtui syyskuun aikana.

Hakkerit ovat hyödyntäneet tanskalaisten yritysten laillista oikeutta hakea tunnuksia rekisteristä, kertovat viranomaiset. Hakkerien tietomurrossa käyttämän yrityksen pääsy rekisteriin on estetty.

TANSKAN tutkimuksesta, koulutuksesta ja digitalisaatiosta vastaava ministeri Christina Egelund kertoo verkkosivuillaan, että asiaankuuluvat viranomaiset selvittävät parhaillaan tapauksen laajuutta.

title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
content:
Recently, multiple organisations have disclosed how clusters of so-called “rogue” AI agents attempted to break into websites and online services, sometimes successfully. Agents from OpenAI’s environment, in particular, are known to have used other public wikis (collaboratively edited websites not owned by us) to communicate and coordinate with each other.

These types of successful intrusions can expose sensitive data or disrupt website services that users rely on, while clusters of agents can attempt attacks at a scale that is difficult for defenders to manage. They affect people behind the websites who may not understand the nature of the attack, or have the tools to effectively fight back. For a site like Wikipedia, agents might find and use security vulnerabilities or make misleading edits at scale. Wikipedia’s volunteer editors and the Wikimedia Foundation’s security teams have to detect and undo that activity.

title: Quantum transition: the current legal and regulatory landscape for businesses
content:
The quantum transition is approaching fast, while the legal and regulatory landscape is only beginning to take shape. For businesses, the question is not whether quantum technologies will reshape opportunities and risks, but how soon and how prepared they will be when it happens. In this alert, our technology lawyers explain why the time to act is now, what practical steps businesses should be taking and why there is no time to wait for the regulatory framework to catch up.

Quantum technology is no longer a distant research concept. The technology is evolving at speed, and we are nearing a “tipping point” where the fruits of research will mature into commercial applications. Organizations that understand the operational and legal implications of quantum transition now will be far better placed and secured than those that wait.

title: As Belarus plans a new unit at Astravyets NPP, experts do not mince their words: A catastrophe is possible
content:
Although Belarus’s 2025 national report presents the plant as very safe, experts are calling for independent international inspections and warn that an additional unit would increase not only the risk of possible accidents, but also the scale of long-term risks associated with radioactive waste and the environment, including the possibility of an environmental disaster.

The latest National Threat Assessment, cited by ELTA, notes that Belarus plans to build a third unit at the Astravyets Nuclear Power Plant alongside the two already in operation.

“Belarusian Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Karankevich publicly announced Belarus’s decision to build a third unit at the Astravyets Nuclear Power Plant site in November 2025. He also said that an assessment of the feasibility of building a new nuclear power plant in the Mogilev Region was continuing,” the intelligence services said.

title: When radio finds a new digital voice: Bringing Romani language and culture online in Kosovo
content:
Language preservation and digital inclusion can go hand in hand

Originally published on Global Voices

Radio Romano Avazo. Composition via Canva Pro.

This article was produced by Durmish Aslano from Radio Romano Avazo through the Digital Spark granting scheme, as part of the Regional Support Mechanism EECA project, implemented by the Metamorphosis Foundation and TechSoup, in partnership with CIVICUS and under the Digital Democracy Initiative (DDI) that covers the Global South. It is being published on Global Voices as part of a content-sharing agreement.

For years, Radio Romano Avazo has been one of the few spaces where the Romani language and culture could be heard consistently in Kosovo. Broadcasting from Prizren, the community radio station has provided content for Roma audiences who often have limited access to media in their mother tongue. 

But as media consumption increasingly moves online, one question became impossible to ignore: What happens to Romani-language content when the radio broadcast ends?

title: Bayan Salehian Arrested and Transferred to Urmia Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Bayan Salehian remains in detention.

Based on information obtained by HRANA, Ms. Salehian was arrested by security forces at her family home on Sunday, September 27, 2026, and subsequently transferred to Urmia Prison. Eight days after her arrest, she remains in a state of legal uncertainty.

An informed source told HRANA that her arrest was related to her participation and remarks in an online discussion. The source added that efforts by her elderly parents to visit their daughter have so far been unsuccessful.

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the charges brought against the physician.

In April of 2025, in a separate case, Ms. Salehian was sentenced to imprisonment and a fine on charges of “propaganda against the regime” and “disseminating false information with the intent to disturb public opinion online.” That case was subsequently closed after completing the judicial process.

She was also arrested and interrogated in October 2024.

Bayan Salehian, an internal medicine specialist residing in Urmia, has previously faced judicial proceedings and convictions.

title: Christa Pike’s Suffering Highlights Inhumanity of Death Penalty
content:
Today, Christa Pike remains unconscious on a ventilator, and in critical condition after the Tennessee government’s failed execution attempt.  

Doctors had warned that her medical condition could make the state’s execution method, lethal injection, exceptionally painful and cruel. In fact, it was barbaric. Authorities tried to insert an IV line for an hour on September 30, using at least seven needles in her left arm. One looked bent as they removed it. Two doses of lethal injection drugs left her unconscious, severely injured, but alive. 

This is the second botched execution in Tennessee over the last several months. Neither case is isolated: nationwide, around 7 percent of execution attempts by lethal injection have either resulted in prolonged visible suffering before death or, as in Pike’s case, left people alive, in some instances only barely. There may be far more suffering that we just can’t see: a federal magistrate judge in Ohio found the dose of one commonly used lethal injection drug is not enough to render the person sufficiently unconscious so they don’t feel “needless pain.”

title: Digital Diogenes or If I Stay Here, Something Precious in Me Will Die
content:
It’s been a long time since images stopped being sacred. They are simply one of the millions of scraps in which I melt.

I am everywhere and everything that can be. And yet I am in a place: this sort of cage called identity, built of fake nostalgia and estrangement from myself. And if I stay here, something precious in me will die.

I dissolve into all the fragments of myself I have chosen to accumulate. The photographs I keep on my phone are not decisions, but rather an unconscious extension of my identity. I am what is worth looking at and, above all, what is worth not deleting.

When I take a photo, or save an image because I find it funny, I do so not as an act of significance, but as a mechanical one because that’s the way of existing online.

title: Internet Archive to Honor Poynter Institute and Investigative Reporters and Editors with 2026 Hero Award for Preserving Local News Online
content:
The Internet Archive is proud to announce that the Poynter Institute and Investigative Reporters and Editors (IRE) will receive the 2026 Internet Archive Hero Award for their leadership in preserving local news online.

The Internet Archive Hero Award recognizes individuals and organizations that have demonstrated leadership in making information available to people around the world. The Poynter Institute, a 50-year-old nonprofit that works to strengthen journalism and train journalists, and IRE, a member-driven nonprofit that has spent 50 years helping journalists do better investigative work, have made preservation a vital part of their work.

Local journalism is the first draft of history, and often the only record of what happened in a community. But as news increasingly moves online, that record is at risk. Stories can disappear when a newsroom closes, a website changes platforms, or digital archives are neglected. At the same time, major news publishers and media organizations are restricting access to web archiving tools like the Wayback Machine, making it harder to preserve the journalism being published today.

title: Moderni yhteiskunta on pyramidihuijaus
content:

title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
content:
Recently, multiple organisations have disclosed how clusters of so-called “rogue” AI agents attempted to break into websites and online services, sometimes successfully. Agents from OpenAI’s environment, in particular, are known to have used other public wikis (collaboratively edited websites not owned by us) to communicate and coordinate with each other.

These types of successful intrusions can expose sensitive data or disrupt website services that users rely on, while clusters of agents can attempt attacks at a scale that is difficult for defenders to manage. They affect people behind the websites who may not understand the nature of the attack, or have the tools to effectively fight back. For a site like Wikipedia, agents might find and use security vulnerabilities or make misleading edits at scale. Wikipedia’s volunteer editors and the Wikimedia Foundation’s security teams have to detect and undo that activity.

title: Cocaine Boatmen Are Being Blown Up By US Airstrikes, But The Drugs Keep Flowing From Colombia
content:
First, you hear the high-pitched whine of drones overhead. Next comes the boom of explosions.

“And then in the following days, the sea brings in a jerrycan, pieces of a boat, drugs, people too,” says Alberto, a local businessman living on the Colombian peninsula of La Guajira.

This grim sequence of events has become familiar for those based along this arid strip of desert, whose shores are lapped by a part of the Caribbean Sea that has been the site of some 20 deadly U.S. strikes on speedboats over the past year.

The U.S. military campaign against the alleged “narco-terrorists” manning these vessels, known as Operation Southern Spear, has faded from headline news since the first attack was launched over a year ago on September 2. 

Yet it continues to destroy small boats in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific — with at least 235 dead in some 70 strikes so far — in the face of heavy criticism from legal experts and rights groups, who call it an ineffective program of what are essentially extrajudicial murders.

title: 300 Years Before ChatGPT, Jonathan Swift’s Gulliver’s Travels Imagined Machines Writing Books and Producing Knowledge (1726)
content: The printing press was invented in the middle of the fifteenth century, and it’s been downhill for the written word ever since. Even before then, arguments that the volume of writing being done far outstripped the value of that writing surely weren’t unheard of. Whatever the era, the most incisive remarks on the apparent victory of verbal quantity over verbal quality tend to have come from writers themselves. No less a satirist than Jonathan Swift made it one of his many targets in Gulliver’s Travels (1726), imagining an elaborate machine of wood and wire called “the Engine” (see illustration above) that automatically generates text, though few remember it — or rather, few remembered it until the rise of large language models in the real world.
