title: Sananvapaus täytyy huomioida turvallisuuspolitiikassa
content:
Sananvapauden suhde kansalliseen turvallisuuteen on monisäikeinen ja haastava. Nopeasti muuttuneessa turvallisuusympäristössä tarvitaan keskustelua sananvapaudesta ja sen turvaamisesta keskeisenä demokraattisena oikeutena.

Sananvapaudessa on kyse jokaisen oikeudesta ilmaista itseään valitsemallaan tavalla, esimerkiksi sosiaalisessa mediassa, poliittisessa mielipideartikkelissa tai vaikka taiteen välityksellä. Sananvapaus on turvattu Suomen perustuslaissa ja kansainvälisissä ihmisoikeussopimuksissa.

Sananvapaus on keskeinen demokraattinen oikeus ja vahva demokratia on olennainen osa kansallista turvallisuuttamme. Valtioneuvoston julkaisema Kansallisen turvallisuuden strategia 2026–35 määrittelee Suomen ydinintresseinä muun muassa demokraattisen valtiojärjestyksen ja oikeusvaltion. Strategian tavoite on yhteiskunnan hyvinvoinnin ja turvallisuuden suojaaminen varmistamalla valtion jatku­vuus, Suomen valtiosuvereniteetin ja alueellisen koskemattomuuden turvaaminen sekä demokraattisen valtiojärjestyksen ja oikeusvaltion suojaaminen, ja yhteiskunnan vakauden vahvistaminen.

title: How ProPublica Reporters Became Private School Owners in 24 Hours
content:
It began as a casual question — and a flicker of curiosity — uttered during a meeting of ProPublica journalists who this year are reporting on publicly funded private schools. We were discussing how, in many states, basically anyone can open a private school wherever they want. No experience, no training, no curriculum required.

One of our editors jumped in and asked: What if ProPublica tried to establish a private school?

We were intrigued. We are longtime education reporters, not educators. Would that matter? Where, if anywhere, do states draw the line on who is fit to run a school — and in some cases, collect public money to fund their ventures? 

We decided that testing the thesis that anyone can open a school would be valuable to our ongoing reporting, particularly at a time when we have found that private schools are growing rapidly across the country — in barns, farms, co-working spaces, people’s homes and parks. These new schools are fueled by taxpayer-funded vouchers and other programs, and our reporting has revealed states have little interest in monitoring them.

content:

Online content in English represents more than half of the written content available on the internet, despite the fact that around 16% of the world's population speaks this language. This inequality is also reflected in the presence of Indigenous and minoritized languages in digital spaces. 

Faced with this scenario, Global Voices and Rising Voices have been promoting initiatives that seek to democratize digital spaces, strengthen linguistic diversity, and contribute to Indigenous and minoritized languages, while also creating networks and connections among communities of speakers. Through campaigns, translation communities, gatherings, and other spaces for peer learning and exchange, these initiatives seek to share technologies that respond to communities’ needs and make visible the different ways in which speakers of these languages are already creating, communicating, and transforming them on the Internet.

title: Arkkitehtuurin Finlandia -palkinto Kuusijärven savusaunoille – ”Julkista rakentamista parhaimmillaan”
content:
Suomen Arkkitehtiliitto SAFA myöntää Arkkitehtuurin Finlandia -palkinnon nyt 13. kerran.

Neljän finalistikohteen joukosta voittajan valitsi tämän vuoden tuomari, eurooppalaiseen filosofiaan ja aatehistoriaan erikoistunut tutkija ja tietokirjailija Timo Miettinen.

Voittajaa valitessaan Timo Miettinen pohti, mikä ehdokkaista ilmaisee parhaiten sitä, mitä suomalaisina olemme tai haluamme olla.

”Kuusijärven savusaunat ovat julkista rakentamista parhaimmillaan. Ne osoittavat, että kauneus, kestävyys ja korkea tekninen laatu voivat kuulua kaikille”, Miettinen sanoo.

”Kohteessa yhdistyvät tekninen taidokkuus, esteettinen herkkyys, yhteisöllisyys, luonnon kunnioittaminen ja saavutettavuus. Se tarjoaa meille kaikille paikan sekä hiljentymiseen että yhdessäoloon.”

Miettinen nostaa perusteluissaan esiin erityisesti saunomisrituaalin ja saunojan kulkemisen rakennuksissa ja niiden välillä.

”Pukuhuoneesta siirrytään ulkotilan kautta saunaan ja edelleen veden äärelle. Metsän tuoksut, viileä ilma, savu ja tummat puupinnat liittyvät osaksi harkittua rituaalia. Saunojen niukka valaistus ja suljettu mittakaava luovat suojan, josta avaudutaan takaisin metsään ja järvimaisemaan”, Miettinen arvioi.

title: Är du konstnär eller författare?
content:
Inom det kommande året blir fem av våra Elfvik-ateljéer lediga. Stipendielägenheterna finns på Busholmen i Helsingfors och kan sökas av professionella konstnärer och författare.

För snart tio år sedan flyttade våra första stipendiater in i de sammanlagt 14 då splitternya Elfvik-ateljélägenheterna på Busholmen i Helsingfors.

Snart tar den femåriga stipendieperioden slut för flera hyresgäster och därför frigörs fem lägenheter under det kommande året.

En lägenhet blir tillgänglig i januari, två i maj och två i oktober 2027.

Ateljélägenheterna är främst för svenskspråkiga professionella konstnärer och skådespelare i Finland. Vi beviljar lägenhetsstipendierna för förtjänstfull verksamhet som skapande konstnär.

Om du uppfyller kriterierna kan du lämna in en ansökan när som helst under året.

Om du redan tidigare har lämnat in en lägenhetsansökan kan du kolla att din ansökan fortfarande är i kraft.

Ansök och kolla din tidigare ansökan via den här webbsidan: https://standertskjold.kulturfonden.fi/

Vi utser nya stipendiater bland dem som lämnat in en lägenhetsansökan efterhand som de nuvarande stipendiaterna flyttar ut.

title: Europe’s AI policing plan stokes privacy concerns
content:
BRUSSELS — Senior EU officials warn that a sweeping new plan to arm the bloc’s police agency, Europol, for the AI era could threaten Europeans’ privacy.

As cybercriminals, terrorists and spies weaponize artificial intelligence for scams, extortion and cyberattacks, Brussels is betting on expanding Europol’s AI powers — the agency that has coordinated European police intelligence since 1998 — to help combat the risks.

“Europol is at a turning point,” said centrist European Parliament member Fabienne Keller, who serves on the justice and civil liberties committee. While “we need a stronger Europol, with the resources and capabilities to effectively support national law enforcement authorities,” Keller said. That “must go hand-in-hand with strong democratic oversight and robust safeguards for fundamental rights and data protection.”

Plans for a “transformative evolution” of the The Hague-based agency, announced this summer, would double its budget to €3 billion and give Europol a hands-on role in fighting new threats, with access to more data and advanced technology.

title: Musiikin käyttö vaalikampanjassa – tarvitsetko luvan?
content:
Miten ehdokkaat saavat käyttää musiikkia vaalikampanjoidensa tilaisuuksissa tai vaalivideoissa? Mitä tarkoitetaan musiikin käytön poliittisella yhteydellä? Kertaamme musiikin poliittisen käytön periaatteet.

Jos haluat käyttää musiikkia vaalikampanjassasi tai muussa poliittisessa yhteydessä, sinun tulee pyytää lupaa sekä kotimaisen että ulkomaisen musiikin käyttöön suoraan musiikin tekijöiltä tai heidän kustantajiltaan. Samalla voit sopia myös mahdollisesta musiikin käytön korvauksesta, jonka musiikin tekijä tai hänen kustantajansa sinulta laskuttaa. Musiikin käyttö poliittisessa yhteydessä kuuluu tekijän itsensä hallinnoimiin taloudellisiin oikeuksiin. Siihen voivat liittyä myös respektioikeudet (moraalinen oikeus), jotka säilyvät aina tekijällä itsellään.

Yhteystietoja voit etsiä:

  • Musiikin tekijöiden (sekä kotimaisten että ulkomaisten) yhteystietojen osalta asiakaspalvelustamme. Asiakaspalvelumme voi myös kertoa, onko teoksella kustantaja, joka hallinnoi teoksen käyttöä tekijän puolesta.
  • Kotimaisilta musiikkikustantajilta, joista useimpien yhteystiedot löytyvät Suomen Musiikkikustantajat ry:n verkkosivuilta.

    • Teosto ei voi myöntää lupaa musiikin käyttöön poliittisessa yhteydessä.

title: How pond algae led to a Nobel prize and a new way to study the brain
content:
Scientists who worked out how to control brain cells with light have won this year’s Nobel prize in physiology or medicine. Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel were honoured for their research into “light-gated ion channels and optogenetics”.

Peter Hegemann, at Humboldt University of Berlin, and Georg Nagel, at the University of Würzburg, wanted to understand how a tiny, single-celled alga called Chlamydomonas senses light. Light-sensing is not unique to animals with eyes: organisms throughout the living world use light to detect their surroundings and respond to changes in their environment. Even single-cell organisms have proteins that respond to light. These proteins are used to move towards or away from light, to generate energy and to respond to the various demands of a 24-hour day.

Hegemann and Nagel discovered that Chlamydomonas has a beautifully ingenious mechanism of light detection that relies on a single protein called channelrhodopsin.

title: Optogenetics wins the Nobel – one neuroscience breakthrough in a line of technological innovations helping scientists map and control the brain
content:
The brain is unbelievably complicated, which is both daunting and fascinating for neuroscientists like me. In the space of a cubic millimeter – about the size of a single poppy seed – there are tens of thousands of neurons and other brain support cells, all influencing each other’s function.

How do neuroscientists make sense of this complexity? And how did they get to the point where they could simply shine different colors of light on the brain to control neuron activity?

The answer is one step at a time, with a lot of help from technology.

Revisiting some of the technological advances that have supported researchers’ current understanding of how the brain works can point to where the field of neuroscience might be going next. There is a rough pattern to the technological advances that have led neuroscience to the present day: visualize the brain, measure its function and then control it.

Using light to influence neuronal function, known as optogenetics, allows neuroscientists to manipulate what neurons do millisecond by millisecond. The researchers whose work led to this technique won the 2026 Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine.

title: atNorth rakentaa uuden datakeskuksen Saloon
content:
Pohjoismaiden johtava suuren tehotiheyden colocation- ja räätälöityjen datakeskusratkaisujen tarjoaja atNorth rakentaa uuden FIN05-datakeskuksen Saloon. Hanke on osa yhtiön vastausta vastuullisen, korkean teholuokan digitaalisen infrastruktuurin kysyntään.

Salo soveltuu rakennuspaikkana hyvin kriittiselle infrastruktuurille, joka palvelee asiakkaita, joille luotettavat verkkoyhteydet ja korkea toimintavarmuus ovat keskeisiä vaatimuksia. Helsingin läheisyys ja suomalaisten teknologia-alan osaajien saatavuus tukevat hankkeen toteutusta.

FIN05 rakennetaan 28,6 hehtaarin maa-alueelle. Ensimmäisen vaiheen 75 MW:n sähköntarve on varmistettu ja koko hankkeen 230 MW:n sähköntarpeen edellyttämät ratkaisut kartoitettu. Kohde kytketään kantaverkkoon Fingridin sähköaseman kautta.

atNorthin oman investoinnin Salon kohteeseen arvioidaan olevan noin 2 miljardia euroa. Arvio ei sisällä atNorthin asiakkaiden omistamia palvelimia eikä niiden asennusta, joihin asiakkaat voivat investoida lisäksi arviolta jopa 10 miljardia euroa.

title: Conservative plans to slash aid budget would ‘irreparably damage’ UK’s global credibility, charities say
content:
Party’s pledge to reduce aid budget from £9bn a year to £1bn to fund new prison places branded as ‘posturing’

Conservative plans to slash the aid budget by 90% would leave the UK unable to cover existing contributions to the UN and World Bank and “irreparably damage” Britain’s global credibility, several organisations and charities have told the Guardian.

In a series of announcements at the Tory party conference in Birmingham, Kemi Badenoch said that as prime minister she would reduce the aid budget from £9bn a year to £1bn, to part-fund 50,000 new prison places in England and Wales. The culture budget would also be slashed by £1bn a year to fund the plans.

title: Mäyrien metsä -valokuvanäyttely
content:
The badgers are likable wanderers of a summer night. They have a strong family bond: The extended family lives in a communal nest and the cubs are cared for together.

Janne Salomeri’s exhibition Badger Forest offers a glimpse into the life of an endearing family of badgers, including the care of the mother and the play and the adventures of the young ones. The photos are taken with a digital camera and processed manually using the Van Dyke -method, which was invented in the 19th century. The result is timeless prints with warm tones.

Janne Salomeri has been photographing nature in the Helsinki area since 2019. Through his photographs, he wishes to show the diversity and the residents of the local nature.

The café follows the museum's opening hours and opens half an hour after the museum itself. Admission to the café is free.

Research groups, artists, photographers, writers, nature enthusiasts, and others interested in nature are welcome to propose exhibitions for the Natural History Museum and the botanical gardens in Kaisaniemi and Kumpula.

title: Minä, luddiitti
content:
Olen viime aikoina ajatellut australialaisen kirjailijan Max Barryn vuonna 2020 julkaistua scifi-kertomusta Providence, jonka luin muutama vuosi sitten. Barryn kirjassa ihmiskunta käy tähtienvälistä sotaa vierasta sivilisaatiota vastaan. Tarina keskittyy neljään astronauttiin Providence-aluksen kyydissä sotaretkellä, joka voi ratkaista koko sodan ja pelastaa ihmiskunnan.

(Spoiler alert: Skippaa seuraavat kaksi kappaletta, jos et halua juonipaljastuksia.)

Juonen juju on se, että avaruusalus on varustettu erittäin kehittyneellä tekoälyllä. Niin kehittyneellä, että astronautit ovat mukana käytännössä sivustakatsojina, joiden ainoa tehtävä on tallentaa ja kertoa matkasta, tuottaa kontsaa kotirintamalle. Avaruusalus tekee omiaan, sen logiikka on matkustajille musta laatikko. Sodan kulkuun ja lopputulokseen ihmisillä ei lopulta ole minkäänlaista vaikutusta. Kirjan tarinan voi tulkita kahdella tapaa: joko niin, että ihmisen merkitys syntyy tarinoista, joita kerromme toisillemme. Tai sitten niin, ettei ihmisillä ole enää merkitystä.

title: Ívar Ölmu (IS)
content:
Ölmu pyrkii projektin myötä tutkimaan ajan kulua veistosten ja keskikoon analogisen valokuvauksen kautta. Hän dokumentoi esineiden, valon ja ympäristön hienovaraista vuorovaikutusta. Residenssi tarjoaa tilat ja puitteet pimiötekniikkojen kokeilua ja pitkäaikaista havainnointia varten, sekä mahdollistaa ajallisuutta ja aineellista muutosta kuvaavan valokuvasarjan sekä veistosten luomisen.

Chronotextures tutkii ajallisina tallenteina toimivien veistosten myötä  ajan, aineellisuuden ja perseption vuorovaikutusta. Ívar Ölmu luo taidetta betonista, metallista sekä orgaanisista materiaaleista ja asettaa ne ympäristöihin, joissa valo, tuuli ja hajoaminen vaikuttaa niihin ajan myötä. Hän käyttää keskikoon analogista valokuvausta dokumentoidakseen hienovaraista muutosta sekä pintajälkeä. Hän luo kuvia, jotka toimivat sekä taiteellisina ilmaisuna että veistosten ajallisen matkan tallenteina.

title: How the Poet Mary Oliver was “Saved by the Beauty of the World”
content:
Filmmaker Sasha Waters wasn’t shy when asked at the National Book Festival about the legacy of her latest documentary subject, the poet Mary Oliver: “I think we’re going to think of her as the (Walt) Whitman of the 20th century.”

That’s an almost impossible standard, as Whitman became synonymous with the American spirit in the late 19th century with poems such as “I Hear America Singing,” “Song of Myself,” “O Captain! My Captain!” and “I Sing the Body Electric.” He has since become an iconic American personality of the age, along with the likes of Abraham Lincoln, Mark Twain and Frederick Douglass.

But Oliver, who adored Whitman’s work, won the Pulitzer Prize and the National Book Award for her rapturous odes to nature and our connection to it. She was adored about as much as any poet since Whitman when she died, at 83, in 2019.

title: Kehitysyhteistyörahan väärinkäytösepäily Tansaniassa
content:
Ulkoministeriö on tietoinen Abilis-säätiön väärinkäytösepäilytapauksesta Tansaniassa ja on ryhtynyt sen osalta toimenpiteisiin. Säätiö on keskeyttänyt asiaan liittyvät maksut. Ulkoministeriö ei kommentoi yksittäistä tapausta tarkemmin. Mikäli ilmenee, että myönnettyä rahoitusta on käytetty väärin, ulkoministeriö tulee tekemään takaisinperinnän valtionavustuslain mukaisesti.

Kehitysyhteistyössä väärinkäytöstapauksia tulee esille aika ajoin. Valtionavustuspäätöksissä ja sopimuksissa edellytetään ilmoittamista kaikista epäilyistä. Kaikki väärinkäytösepäilyt selvitetään niistä annetun normin ja ohjeistuksen mukaisesti.

Kehitysyhteistyöhön liittyviä riskejä arvioidaan, ennakoidaan ja seurataan tarkasti, mutta joskus ne toteutuvat varotoimenpiteistä huolimatta. Riskienhallinnan menetelmiä kehitetään jatkuvasti.

title: Ivar Ölmu (IS)
content:
The project aims to explore time’s flow through sculpture and medium-format analog photography, documenting subtle interactions between objects, light, and the environment. The residency offers space and facilities to experiment with darkroom techniques and extended observation, allowing him to develop a series of photographs and sculptures that capture and reflect on temporality and material change.

Chronotextures explores the interplay between time, materiality, and perception through sculptures that act as temporal records. Ívar Ölmu creates works from materials like concrete, metal, and organic matter and places them in environments where light, wind, and decay interact with them over time. Using medium-format analogue photography, the artist documents subtle changes and surface imprints, producing 3 images that function as both artistic expressions and records of the sculptures’ temporal journey.

title: Ívar Ölmu (IS)
content:
Projektet syftar till att utforska tidens flöde genom skulptur och analog mellanformatsfotografi, och dokumentera subtila interaktioner mellan objekt, ljus och omgivning. Residenset erbjuder utrymme och faciliteter för att experimentera med mörkrumstekniker och fördjupad observation, vilket gör det möjligt för mig att utveckla en serie fotografier och skulpturer som fångar och reflekterar över temporalitet och materiell förändring.

Chronotextures utforskar samspelet mellan tid, materialitet och perception genom skulpturer som fungerar som tidsliga register. Ölmu skapar verk av material som betong, metall och organiskt material och placerar dem i miljöer där ljus, vind och nedbrytning påverkar dem över tid. Med hjälp av analog mellanformatsfotografi dokumenterar konstnären subtila förändringar och avtryck på ytorna, och producerar 3 bilder som fungerar både som konstnärliga uttryck och som dokumentation av skulpturernas tidsliga resa.

title: arXiv Is Rate Limiting Submissions Because It Can’t Keep up With AI Slop
content:
arXiv, an open-access repository where researchers publish preprint academic research, has announced it will rate limit submissions because it has been inundated with AI-written papers. A researcher can now only send in two pieces per calendar month and have a total of three active submissions at any given time. In a blog post about the change, arXiv said AI has made it too easy to spam the publisher’s inbox and its volunteer moderation team is overwhelmed.

“The heart of arXiv’s process for detecting and rejecting low-quality papers is our many volunteer moderators,” Thomas Dietterich, an Oregon State University professor emeritus and the chair of arXiv’s editorial advisory council said in a statement. “We are so grateful that they donate their time and expertise every day. However, a relatively small proportion of authors are submitting a large number of low-quality papers and consuming a disproportionate fraction of the moderators’ time. This is unfair to authors who continue to submit quality papers — their papers can be delayed for days or weeks as a result.”

title: Kertomuksia hiljaisuudesta. Sananvapausverkosto kirjamessuilla
content:
Kenen ääni kuuluu – ja kuka jää kuulematta? Sananvapausverkosto vie syksyllä Kertomuksia hiljaisuudesta -keskustelusarjan neljille kirjamessuille. Tutkijat, taiteilijat, journalistit ja muut asiantuntijat keskustelevat siitä, mikä saa ihmiset vaikenemaan ja millaiset rakenteet vaikuttavat siihen, ketkä pääsevät yhteiskunnassa ääneen.

Sanan- ja ilmaisunvapaus ovat tutkijoiden, taiteilijoiden ja toimittajien työn keskeisiä edellytyksiä. Heidän työnsä perustuu mahdollisuuteen tuottaa, tulkita ja jakaa tietoa, ajatuksia ja näkökulmia vapaasti myös silloin, kun ne haastavat totuttuja käsityksiä tai herättävät yhteiskunnallista keskustelua.

Kertomuksia hiljaisuudesta -lavaohjelmissa kuullaan kokemuksia ilmaisunvapauden merkityksestä ja siihen kohdistuvista paineista tutkimuksen, taiteen ja journalismin kentillä. Esiin nousevat vaikeat ja vaietut aiheet sekä kysymys siitä, keiden ääni yhteiskunnassa kuuluu ja kuka jää kuulematta.

title: Russia Attacks – Would NATO Freeze?
content:
Would NATO fight if Russia entered its territory? Yes, says CEPA Fellow Skip Davis, but it’s also the case that alliance readiness has been increased across the eastern flank in the last decade and now extends far beyond the ability to meet an armed attack.

Question: What would happen on the ground if Russian troops crossed into NATO territory? Would alliance commanders need to await permission to engage?

Davis: NATO forward land forces are multinational battle groups and brigades stationed on the eastern flank, mostly in countries bordering Russia. They have a lead nation, but they’re established in nine different countries along the east, from Finland all the way down to Romania, all the Baltics, Poland and Slovakia, Hungary. Under NATO doctrine, they have the right to respond in self-defense. They would not need permission to respond.

But that is the simplest response. We have to peel the onion a little bit because Russia would normally be expected to do some type of preparation.

title: "I Am Jane Doe": Cornell Case Reignites Debate over Rape Culture, Frats & Prosecuting Sex Crimes
content:
Revelations of sexual assault at a Cornell University fraternity in 2024 and how the university responded have sparked national outrage, reigniting a public debate about “the extent to which fraternities, the extent to which athletics really support this kind of culture that allows perpetrators to escape with little or no accountability,” says law professor Deborah Tuerkheimer.

In 2024, seven male students avoided criminal prosecution after allegedly drugging and gang-raping a female student at the Chi Phi fraternity house. Cornell is now under intense scrutiny for its handling of the original investigation, which found that the student identified as Jane Doe was sexually assaulted by two of seven men, resulting in expulsions for two and lesser consequences for the other five. Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten has admitted that his office at the time did not independently investigate the case when it declined to bring charges. The DA has now reopened the case, and New York Governor Kathy Hochul has named Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor to investigate how the case was handled.

Ministeriö kertoi ryhtyneensä epäilyn osalta toimenpiteisiin, mutta ei kommentoinut tapausta tarkemmin.

Kehitysyhteistyössä väärinkäytöstapauksia tulee ministeriön mukaan esille aika ajoin. Mikäli ilmenee, että myönnettyä rahoitusta on käytetty väärin, ulkoministeriö kertoo tekevänsä takaisinperinnän valtionavustuslain mukaisesti.

VAMMAISTYÖTÄ tekevän Abilis-säätiön mukaan epäilty väärinkäytös on kokoluokaltaan kymmeniätuhansia euroja. Ensimmäisten epäiltyjen väärinkäytösten arvioidaan tapahtuneen vuonna 2020.

Säätiö on keskeyttänyt kaikki maksut Tansanian maaohjelmaan ja kertoo tarkastelevansa sisäisiä prosessejaan.

title: How Wiki Loves Earth’s images expressed love in 2026
content:
If humanity truly wants to understand the meaning of love, we must look to nature and animals to see how love is instinctively formed, and how feelings arise without words. Nature has taught us profound lessons without speaking to us directly, simply observing the behavior of the creatures around us is enough to reveal the meanings of loyalty, care, attachment, and love.

This is precisely what I noticed while contemplating the results of Wiki Loves Earth 2026. In some of the images, I saw more than just documentation of nature; I saw scenes that reminded us, as humans, of what it means to love instinctively.

title: Innovation & Law: EmpCo, viherväittämät ja kuluttajansuojasääntelyn ajankohtaiset teemat 26.10.2026
content:
Ympäristöystävällisyydestä on tullut monelle yritykselle keskeinen kilpailutekijä. Aiheen merkityksen kasvaessa tulee kuitenkin pohdittavaksi, miten arvoista ja investoinneista sen hyväksi voi todellisuudessa viestiä, kun jo itse ”ympäristöystävällinen”-sanan käyttäminen markkinoinnissa on kielletty.

Tervetuloa aamiaistilaisuuteemme, jossa käymme läpi konkreettisten esimerkkien ja käytännön ratkaisujen kautta EmpCo-direktiivin ja viherväittämien sääntelyn vaikutusta yritysten liiketoimintaan juuri nyt. Sivuamme samalla myös muita ajankohtaisia markkinoinnin ja kuluttajansuojan teemoja ja muutoksia.

Tilaisuudessa asiantuntijamme avaavat, mitä yrityksen kannattaa ottaa huomioon esimerkiksi tuotepakkauksissa, markkinointiväittämissä ja niiden todentamisessa – niin riskien välttämiseksi kuin kilpailuedun hyödyntämiseksi.

  • Miten vertailevia väittämiä voi hyödyntää vastuullisuusmarkkinoinnissa – ja missä kulkee raja hyväksyttävän ja harhaanjohtavan vertailun välillä?

title: Bangladeshi Police Round Up Opposition Supporters
content:
The mass arrest of attendees at a small left-wing party’s meeting in Dhaka on September 26 is the latest incident in the Bangladesh authorities’ ongoing assault on civil and political rights.

Police took around 290 supporters of the Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal into custody after members of the ruling Bangladesh Nationalist Party’s youth wing – the Jubo Dal – claimed the gathering was a “secret” meeting of the former prime minister Sheikh Hasina’s Awami League, which is banned. A court remanded 27 of those arrested to custody, because it was alleged they had chanted the slogan “Joy Bangla” (Victory to Bengal), a slogan associated with the Awami League.

The Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal was part of a 14-party alliance, led by the Awami League, that governed Bangladesh from 2009 until 2024, when it was toppled by student led protests in which hundreds were killed by security forces.

The current ruling party, the Bangladesh National Party, faced severe repression under the Awami League government. Since being elected in February, it has targeted its own perceived opponents with arbitrary detention and hundreds of Awami League members are currently in jail, mostly without charge.

title: Hilda Hellström gästar Astra Art Talk den 7 oktober / Hilda Hellström vierailee Astra Art Talk -keskustelusarjassa 7. lokakuuta
content:
Den svenska konstnären Hilda Hellström besöker Astra i Åbo den 7 oktober som gäst i samtalsserien Astra Art Talk. Under kvällen berättar hon om sitt konstnärskap, arbetsprocessen bakom det platsspecifika verket Passage of Time och hur geologi, arkeologi och historia formar hennes konstnärliga uttryck.

Astra Art Talk är en ny samtalsserie på svenska som lyfter fram konsten i campusbyggnaden Astra och de konstnärer vars verk finns representerade i byggnaden och dess omgivning. Serien vill skapa möten mellan konstnärer, universitetssamfundet och den breda allmänheten samt öppna upp för samtal om konstens roll i utbildnings- och forskningsmiljöer.

– Universitet är platser för kritiskt tänkande, reflektion och kunskapssökande. Med Astra Art Talk vill vi öppna dörren till de berättelser som finns bakom konsten och skapa utrymme för samtal om konstens betydelse i vår gemensamma miljö, säger Stiftelsens för Åbo Akademi intendent Ulrika Grägg.

Hilda Hellström är utbildad inom både konst och design och är känd för sina skulpturala verk där traditionella hantverksmetoder kombineras med okonventionella material och tekniker. Inspirationen hämtar hon ofta från geologi, arkeologi och historia.

title: Prosecution of Tren de Aragua Accused Mastermind Deemed Complex Case
content:
A suspected cybercriminal who allegedly bankrolled the notorious Tren de Aragua gang through a multimillion-dollar ATM fraud scheme was arrested and will remain behind bars to face a complex prosecution in Nebraska, just days after the Venezuelan was blacklisted by the Treasury Department.

In a news conference Saturday in Omaha that began with, “well we got him,” FBI Special Agent in Charge Eugene Kowel said Anibal Alexander Canelón Aguirre, an alleged computer whiz and hacker tied to the transnational gang, was captured on the high seas.

During his news conference, Kowel said the FBI in Omaha received assistance from the U.S. Coast Guard and the FBI's Critical Incident Response Group. Canelón Aguirre, he said, was subsequently transported by sea and air to the District of Nebraska.

The FBI’s web page for its most-wanted fugitives now shows a red bar across his photo reading “Captured.”

However, Kowel’s account contrasts with statements made just weeks earlier by FBI Director Kash Patel. During a Senate hearing, Patel announced the fugitive’s capture in Venezuela without explicitly naming him or providing further details.

title: Artists Frida Kahlo & Diego Rivera Visit Leon Trotsky in Mexico: Vintage Footage from 1938
content:
Here’s some rare footage of the great Mexican painters Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo paying a visit to exiled Soviet revolutionary Leon Trotsky and his wife, Natalia Sedova, in Coyoacán, Mexico, in 1938.

The Trotskys had arrived the year before, after Rivera petitioned the government of President Lázaro Cárdenas to grant the controversial Marxist leader and theorist sanctuary in Mexico. When the Trotskys arrived on a Norwegian oil tanker at the port city of Tampico in January of 1937, Rivera was not well, but Kahlo boarded the ship to welcome the Trotskys and accompanied them on an armored train to Mexico City. She invited the Trotskys to stay at her family home, La Casa Azul (the Blue House) in Coyoacán, now a section of Mexico City. By the time this footage was taken by a visiting American named Ivan Heisler, Trotsky and Kahlo had either had, or were about to have, a brief affair, and the friendship between the two couples would soon fall apart. In early 1939 Trotsky moved to another house in the same neighborhood, where he was assassinated in August of 1940.

title: Oklahoma Oil Company Plugs Disposal Well That Posed Threat to City’s Drinking Water
content:
An Oklahoma oil and gas company plugged a well that disposes of oil production’s toxic byproduct after an investigation by The Frontier and ProPublica revealed that regulators had approved the well in violation of state rules meant to protect public groundwater supplies.

The disposal well, named the Flying Monkey, injected oil field wastewater underground and sat roughly a quarter-mile from two municipal groundwater supply sites that served the small city of Enid in northwest Oklahoma. Wastewater injection operations are banned within a half-mile of public water wells unless regulators hold a hearing to ensure that this activity will not pollute groundwater. Regulators at the Oklahoma Corporation Commission did not hold a hearing before approving the well in 2018.

The city of Enid filed a complaint last year asking the state to revoke the Flying Monkey’s permit to operate.

title: 50 members of European Parliament targeted by deepfake porn, report says
content:
Fifty European Union lawmakers, including 46 women, have been the targets of deepfake pornography, according to new research released Monday.

The number of women targeted by deepfake pornography — when generative AI is used to create sexually explicit depictions of people, often without their consent — means roughly one in six female members of the European Parliament have been affected, the report by Agora Digitale Transformation, a Germany-based civil society group, said.

The European Union is banning AI-powered nudifier apps on Dec. 2, and is also investigating similar use of Grok on the social media platform X.

A cross-party group of 119 MEPs called for effective enforcement of the ban and prompt resolution of the investigation into Grok, in a Sept. 30 letter sent to Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, the head of the Council of the EU Antonio Costa, Parliament President Roberta Metsola, EU tech chief Henna Virkkunen and Commissioner Hadja Lalhbib. The signatories included leaders of the liberal Renew, the socialists, and The Left: Iratxe Garcia Pérez, Valérie Hayer, and Manon Aubry, respectively.

title: Brazil election: Authoritarian right gain an edge, fueled by voter apathy and discontent
content:
The far-right bubble that has seen populist rightist figures elected across Latin America spilled over and flooded the ballot box in Brazil’s general elections held on Oct. 4, 2026 – fueled by a discontented and distrustful public. In spite of voting being mandatory in the country for literate citizens aged 18 to 70, a wave of disengagement swept across 33.4 million voters who did not cast a ballot — 21% of the electorate.

It was the highest abstention rate since 1998. We still need to investigate what produces bubbles and waves in contemporary politics, but I have a few tentative hypotheses about this process.

This kind of ebb and flow has three dimensions: affective, value-based, and political-ideological. The affective dimension is one of depressive sentiments. Three feelings predominate: resentment, anger and political fatigue. Anger stems from the fear of losing what one has and from the aversion generated by feeling neglected by the political leadership in power. Under affective polarization, it turns into hatred.

title: Voiko kvanttiakku olla sekä nopea että vakaa?
content:
Kvanttifysiikan epätarkkuusperiaate aiheuttaa kvanttiakuissa perustavan ristiriidan, joka rajoittaa niiden kykyä tuottaa samanaikaisesti vakaata tehoa ja energiaa. Oulun yliopiston tutkijat ovat nyt määrittäneet fysiikan asettamat rajat.

Kvanttiakut ovat nouseva tutkimusala, joka keskittyy teoreettisiin tutkimuksiin ja pienillä kvanttijärjestelmillä tehtäviin mallinnoksiin. Toisin kuin arkielämässä käytettävät tavanomaiset kemialliset akut, kvanttiakut varastoivat ja siirtävät energiaa kvanttilaitteiden, kuten kvanttibittien eli kubittien avulla. Niitä tutkitaan tulevaisuuden energialähteinä kvanttiprosessoreille ja muille kvanttiteknologioille. Aiemmissa tutkimuksissa on keskitytty siihen, kuinka nopeasti ja suurella teholla kvanttiakkuja voidaan ladata.

Uudessa tutkimuksessa tutkijat määrittivät rajat kvanttiakun energiasisällön ja sen luovutusnopeuden vaihteluille. Tutkimus julkaistiin äskettäin PRX Quantum -tiedelehdessä.

title: Meta Rushed to Fix Muse ‘VM Escape' Vulnerability Soon Before Launch
content:
In the immediate weeks before Muse’s launch, Meta engineers found several security vulnerabilities in the company’s viral AI agent product, at least one of which could have allowed malicious users to break outside of Muse’s intended environment and access Meta’s own sensitive databases and services, 404 Media has learned. The issues were so severe that they reached Mark Zuckerberg and staff worked overtime to fix them.

These specific vulnerabilities were discovered before the launch of the product but required a multi-team “mad dash” to fix “a sudden spike in reported KVM escapes,” according to an internal post by Meta executives to its core infrastructure team seen by 404 Media. In order for Muse to work, a user gives the AI agent access to various important services and accounts that they own. On Meta’s end, each individual Muse instance runs on a kernel-based virtual machine, which connects to, but is supposed to be isolated from, Meta’s own critical infrastructure. A “KVM escape,” then, is when, through a security vulnerability, a Muse instance is able to escape from that virtual machine and interact with the system that runs it, or with other users’ virtual machines.

title: The Czechs: 1938 and All That
content:
October 28 is the 108th anniversary of the creation of the Czechoslovak Republic, a new but old country wrenched from the talons of the dying Austro-Hungarian Empire in 1918.

September 30, meanwhile, marked the 88th anniversary of the Munich Agreement, when the country was abandoned by its allies, and its German-speaking borderlands sliced off and handed to Herr Hitler.

It’s always a time for soul-searching. Politicians, historians and the media ponder what went wrong in the 20 years after 1918, and what’s gone right in the 37 years since 1989.

These days, with a new war raging to the country’s east, the soul-searching can get fraught, and at times hysterical.

“We’re living in 1938. It’s just a question of which month,” is a typical response from doom-mongers on X scouring the horizon for signs of Russian tank divisions rolling past the Tesco’s in Prague 10.

“Never mind 1938. It’s already 1939,” say others, peering anxiously at the skies for drones.

It’s not.

Czechoslovakia’s fate was awful, but it’s hard to see any other outcome given the set of circumstances in which Central Europe’s sole surviving democracy found itself in 1938.

title: Far Right Makes Gains in Brazil as Flávio Bolsonaro Tops Lula in First Round of Presidential Race
content: Brazil’s presidential election is headed to a runoff between leftist incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after neither candidate cleared 50% in Sunday’s vote, in which the right made gains in Congress and in governor races across the country. Bolsonaro received 47% of the vote compared to Lula’s 45%. The second round of voting is on October 25. If elected, Flávio Bolsonaro has vowed to grant amnesty to his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest and serving a 27-year sentence for plotting a coup in 2022 to overturn Lula’s last victory. He has also vowed to strengthen ties to the Trump administration, which is accused of trying to influence the result in Bolsonaro’s favor.

title: Arvio: Väinö Hakkila, eduskunnan suurin koiranleuka ja unohdettu valtiomies
content:
Tuoreen elämäkerran kirjoittaja Jukka-Pekka Pietiäinen arvioi Väinö Hakkilan olevan ”unohdettu valtiomies”.

Väitteessä on perää. Hakkila on jäänyt varjoon, vaikka hän oli kansanedustajana viidellä eri vuosikymmenellä ja eduskunnan puhemiehenä yhdeksän vuotta.

Yksi syy unohdukseen saattaa olla siinä, että Hakkila ei 1920-luvun alkuvuosia lukuunottamatta kuulunut SDP:n puoluejohtoon eli puoluetoimikuntaan. Hakkila oleskeli Helsingissä vain eduskunnan istuessa. Muulloin hän asui kotonaan Tampereella ja hoiti siellä kunnallispormestarin tehtäviä.

Puolueen papereita tutkimalla Hakkila on toki läsnä mutta ei eturivissä. Toisin on, kun tutkija, tässä tapauksessa Pietiäinen tutustuu eduskunnan pöytäkirjoihin.

Ainakin allekirjoittaneelle on yllätys, millainen palopuhuja ja välihuutaja Hakkila oli. Kansan Lehti luonnehti häntä 70-vuotisjutussaan eduskunnan kaikkien aikojen suurimmaksi koiranleuaksi.

Sananruoskaa Väinö Hakkila heilutti poliittisia vastustajiaan kohtaan 1920- ja 1930-luvuilla niin tiuhaan, että sai varsinkin äärioikeiston vihat päälleen. Viha äityi väkivallaksi kun Hakkila 1930 kyyditettiin Lapualle.

title: Adventures, Comrades, and Endless Memories: My Wikimedia CEE Meeting Impressions
content:
International conferences are never just about formal sessions and presentations. My journey to the Wikimedia CEE Meeting 2026 in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, gave me far more than professional experience, it brought me lifelong memories, funny moments, and unforgettable friendships.

My trip kicked off on September 16th with a night flight. During the layover in Istanbul, I had the wonderful chance to meet members of the Georgian Wikimedia community and received a special gift for the Turkic Marathon. But international travel rarely goes smoothly… Upon arriving in Cluj, my luggage was severely damaged and practically unusable, and to top it all off, I accidentally checked into the wrong hotel!

Because of these minor misadventures, I arrived at the Learning Day a bit late. From the very first minutes, my inner paparazzo kicked in, and I started capturing my new acquaintance, Nal Mencin, on camera, a habit that continued right up until the end of the conference.

title: Legal Morning Club -webinaari
content:
Juridisten neuvonantajien käytännön vinkit ja kokemukset kyberhyökkäysten ja tietoturvaloukkausten strategisesta hallinnasta.

Tässä Legal Morning Club -webinaarissa tarkastelemme viimeaikaisia trendejä ja haastavimpia juridisia kysymyksiä kyberhyökkäysten ja tietoturvaloukkausten kentällä. Geopoliittinen tilanne ja uudet teknologiat tietomurtojen välineenä ovat luoneet uuden riskiympäristön jokaisen organisaation kyberturvalle ja toimintavarmuudelle. Samaan aikaan tietoturvapoikkeamiin liittyvät toimintavelvollisuudet ovat monimutkaistuneet uuden sääntelyn ja kehittyvien viranomaiskäytäntöjen myötä.

Minkälainen pelikirja organisaatiolla tulee olla onnistuneen poikkeamahallinnan varmistamiseksi? Milloin on ilmoitettava ja milloin voi jättää ilmoittamatta? Miten varmistaa ICT:n, legalin, compliancen, riskienhallinnan ja johdon riittävä yhteistyö?

Asiantuntijamme Jukka Lång, Johanna Tuohino ja Oskari Paasikivi tuovat selkeyttä näihin kysymyksiin muun muassa seuraavien teemojen kautta:

  • Onnistuneen poikkeamahallinnan merkitys ja toteutus vuonna 2026
  • Mihin ilmoituskynnykset ovat asettuneet käytännössä? Milloin ilmoittaa ja kenelle?

title: January 2026 Protests: Alireza Raisi Executed
content:
Based on information obtained by HRANA, Alireza Raisi was executed at dawn today, Monday, October 5, 2026, at Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan.

An informed source close to the Raisi family told HRANA about the hours leading up to the execution, saying that Mr. Raisi met with his family for the final time on Sunday, October 4. At the end of the visit, he refused to part from his family, and prison authorities and officers ultimately separated him from them by force. According to the source, members of his family also gathered outside Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan last night, seeking information about his situation.

Mr. Raisi’s death sentence was carried out at the same time as that of Alireza Sepahi, another defendant in the case.

Alireza Raisi had previously been sentenced to death along with several other defendants in the case known as the “Isfahan Alikhani Square” case. At the trial-court stage, 15 defendants in the case were sentenced to death. According to information provided by an attorney, the sentence of one defendant was overturned by a higher judicial authority, while the death sentences of the other 14 defendants were upheld.

title: Iraq: Dire Prospects for Alleged ISIS-Linked Men, Boys
content:
(Beirut) – Nearly 5,700 men and boys held as alleged Islamic State (ISIS) members and transferred to Iraq in early 2026 are at risk of abuse including imminent prosecution for adults in unfair trials, followed by execution, Human Rights Watch said today. Dozens of countries are stalling on repatriating and providing aid to their detained nationals amid torture allegations, grave illnesses, and several deaths in custody.

The detainees, about 3,500 from Syria and 2,200 from Iraq and 65 other countries, were already held in life-threatening conditions for up to seven-and-a-half years in northeast Syria. None of the foreigners were prosecuted or charged, making their prolonged detention in Syria arbitrary and unlawful. The US military abruptly transferred them to Iraq between January 21 and February 12, 2026. 

“The thousands of boys and men sent to Iraq deserve humane treatment and due process, just as the thousands of survivors of ISIS crimes deserve genuine justice,” said Letta Tayler, senior counterterrorism advisor at Human Rights Watch. “The international community shouldn’t leave Iraq to manage this immense responsibility on its own.”

title: Merz and Macron want the EU to hit back harder — and faster — against trade threats
content:
BERLIN — The European Commission needs the power to act much faster against trade threats, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and French President Emmanuel Macron urged in a joint letter on Monday.

The leaders of the EU’s two most powerful and populous countries want Brussels to be able to act more quickly and decisively in a trade confrontation — while making it harder for EU capitals to block action.

The proposal seeks to strengthen the hand of Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič, who flies to Beijing on Thursday for the final round of talks in a four-month process where Brussels is seeking to rebalance the EU’s trading relationship with China.

Merz and Macron said the Commission should be empowered to restrict, or even completely cut off, imports from countries seen as creating “severe and systematic distortions” in the single market. In their letter and a joint position paper, they call for urgent action, saying the EU’s existing trade defense toolbox “does not suffice anymore.”

“Without delaying the full use of the existing set of instruments, we need a comprehensive framework to complement our toolbox with new legal instruments — in a lean and non-bureaucratic way,” they wrote.

title: Africa’s rhinos often get the spotlight – but Indonesia’s two rhino species are far closer to extinction
content:
Small, hairy and cheekily charismatic.

Those words sprung to mind when I first met a Sumatran rhinoceros (Dicerorhinus sumatrensis) after traversing the maze of wooden slatted paths at the conservation centre in the dense, humid forests of Malaysian Borneo.

It was 1998 and I was an eager student volunteer at the centre. At that time, 300 Sumatran rhinos were thought to exist globally.

I saw this female rhino as a symbol of conservation hope. But today, according to the International Rhino Foundation’s 2026 State of the Rhino report, less than 50 Sumatran rhinos remain. All are found in Indonesia. The Javan rhino (Rhinoceros sondaicus) is just as rare.

While these figures rely on estimates, the trajectory is alarming.

So what is driving this decline? And how can we protect the few Sumatran and Javan rhinos that are left?

In modern culture, rhinos represent strength, power and security. We use them as sports mascots and feature them in everything from car logos to safety equipment brands.

Their ubiquity in popular culture may lead us to underestimate the urgency of their plight. Species used as marketing emblems are often considered more common than they truly are.
snippet: Small, hairy and cheekily charismatic.
creator: Michelle Campbell-Ward, Associate Professor, Wildlife and Avian Medicine, University of Sydney

title: Call for Papers: Theorising Networks. Relational Frameworks in Archaeology and History
content:
This workshop builds on a previous meeting held in Helsinki in 2021 (Lahelma, Dawson & Micale 2025), which highlighted the diversity of network applications and their potential for explaining interaction and connectivity. It moves further by addressing a critical need to rethink the theoretical foundations and directions of network analysis, reshaping how the past is conceptualised and interpreted through its application to the archaeological and historical record.

Over the past two decades, network thinking has become a central framework for investigating cultural interaction in the ancient world. However, its rapid adoption has often been “overly method-driven” (Brughmans & Peeples 2023: 264). This workshop addresses this gap by foregrounding the theoretical and epistemological implications of network approaches. It moves beyond treating networks as purely analytical tools and positions them instead as a framework for rethinking the ancient world as fundamentally relational: an interconnected web of people, objects, animals, places, practices, and ideas (Terrell, Golitko, Dawson & Kissel 2023).

title: Putin and His War Without End
content:
One characteristic of dictators and despots is that they speak for as long as they like. It’s a defining feature that brevity is discarded while verbosity prospers. Putin offered a good example when he used an address at the Valdai Forum on October 1 to ramble on for 3 hours and 20 minutes. There then followed a moderated discussion on stage.

For those seeking a clue about the Kremlin’s future direction of Kremlin, there were some hints. The bad news is that these were mostly extremely bleak.

Five key points of his strategy can be gleaned from his lengthy remarks:

1. Offense is defense

Putin’s central strategy and his ultimate goal is to reframe every instance of Russian aggression as a defensive necessity. He claims that Russia is merely responding to Western attacks or provocations.

This narrative is the foundation of his entire policy:

Putin justifies the war of aggression against Ukraine as a defense against the aggressive West. It is fair to summarize his statements as showing that he is preparing the population for a protracted confrontation while portraying every escalation — past and future — as a “response” and never as a Russian initiative.

title: Nyt tuli päätös: käräjäoikeus hylkäsi Oulun ex-kaupunginjohtajan virkarikossyytteen
content:
Käräjäoikeus on hylännyt Oulun entisen kaupunginjohtajan virkarikossyytteen. Syyttäjä vaati Päivi Laajalalle rangaistusta tapauksessa, jossa hänen alaisensa muun muassa otti käyttöönsä kaupungin lukuun hankitun auton.

title: From Local Contributions to a Global Movement: My Wikimania 2026 Journey
content:
For me, Wikimania 2026 was not simply a conference in Paris. It was a journey that connected many parts of my Wikimedia experience – learning, volunteering, meeting people from different communities, exploring new ideas, and contributing to the free knowledge movement in my own way.

When I received the opportunity to attend Wikimania 2026 in Paris, I knew that this would be a very different experience from participating in Wikimedia activities from Odisha. Wikimania brought together Wikimedians from different countries, languages, backgrounds, and communities. The 2026 edition was held from 21 to 25 July at the Cité des Sciences et de l’Industrie in Paris, under the theme “Freedom, Equity, Reliability.” It was also a special year because Wikipedia was celebrating its 25th anniversary.

Coming to Paris for my second Wikimania was a very different experience. This time, I was not completely new to the Wikimedia community. I already knew some people from my previous Wikimania experience and from my interactions within the movement, while many others were new faces whose work and communities I was getting to know for the first time.

title: World Teachers’ Day: At Least 47 Iranian Teachers Imprisoned, Detained, or in Exile
content:
World Teachers’ Day, observed annually on October 5, has been commemorated since 1994 and marks the anniversary of the adoption of the 1966 ILO/UNESCO Recommendation concerning the Status of Teachers. The document addresses, among other issues, teachers’ rights and responsibilities, conditions of employment, and standards for their working conditions and education.

Overview of Teachers’ Current Status

These 47 teachers are spread across 19 provinces in Iran. Razavi Khorasan has the highest number on the list, with eight individuals. It is followed by Fars and Khuzestan provinces, with five each; North Khorasan, with four; and Alborz and West Azerbaijan, with three each.

Kurdistan, Kermanshah, Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad, Markazi, Isfahan, and Tehran each have two individuals on the list, while Lorestan, Bushehr, Kerman, Zanjan, Gilan, Qazvin, and Ilam each have one.

title: Afghans Await Justice 25 Years After War Began
content:
(Washington, DC) – The United States and coalition countries have yet to provide genuine justice or redress for war crimes and other grave abuses in Afghanistan in the 25 years since the war began on October 7, 2001, Human Rights Watch said today, issuing a timeline of its reporting of the conflict. 

After Al-Qaeda’s September 11 attacks on the United States, the US government authorized the use of interrogation methods of suspected militants amounting to torture. Human Rights Watch and others also documented torture and other ill-treatment by US forces in Afghanistan, including beatings, humiliation, waterboarding, prolonged sleep deprivation, and mock executions. Many civilian detainees were released only after months or years without ever being charged with a crime. The US government has never provided full accountability or compensation for these abuses.

This feature compiles Human Rights Watch reporting on international human rights and humanitarian law issues by all parties during the conflict and the continuing need for accountability.

title: Emmanuel Macron is most impressive world leader on AI, says Sam Altman
content:
OpenAI’s Sam Altman named French President Emmanuel Macron as the world leader who stands out for their approach to AI in an exclusive interview with Decoded by POLITICO.

“The person that came to mind as you were saying that is the French president,” Altman told Decoded co-author and POLITICO senior tech reporter Brendan Bordelon in response to being asked who has impressed him the most with their AI policy or plans for the technology.

“I think [Macron] is extremely thoughtful and has been for a long time about where this is going and what the shape of it needs to look like,” Altman said.

The recognition is notable because Macron has sought to use his leadership to push AI safety on the global stage, and because the French president is months away from leaving office.

After two terms as president, Macron is barred from running in the next election in April 2027. The far-right candidate Marine Le Pen, who is leading in the polls, is advocating a policy of deregulation on AI, three senior party officials told POLITICO.

title: Three years after October 7, global attention on Gaza has receded. The real test will come after Israel’s election
content:
This week marks three years since Hamas’ massacre of October 7 2023, in which some 1,200 people, most of them Israeli civilians, were killed and 251 taken hostage.

What followed were two years of devastating war waged by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) in Gaza, which a UN commission of inquiry, leading genocide scholars and major human rights organisations have concluded amounted to genocide. Much of the strip lies in ruins and more than 74,000 Palestinians are dead, with thousands more believed to remain buried under the rubble.

A year ago this week, a US-imposed ceasefire was finally forced on both sides – though mainly on paper. While major IDF assaults have ceased, Israeli attacks in Gaza have continued, in addition to unbridled Jewish settler violence in the West Bank.

Despite this, global attention on Gaza has waned. As the US–Israeli war with Iran began dominating the headlines, earlier pledges by many states to help drive the peace process forward have proved once again wanting, even hollow.
snippet: This week marks three years since Hamas’ massacre of October 7 2023, in which some 1,200 people, most of them Israeli civilians, were killed and 251 taken hostage.

title: ”Tekoälytaitoja pitää opettaa kouluissa ja oppilaitoksissa”
content:
The gloomiest visions for AI depict the total annihilation of education and learning. 

To prevent this, the idea of learning with AI must be introduced in everyday life at schools and other educational institutions. This is what , Professor of Higher Education and Vice-Dean for Research at the University of Helsinki's Faculty of Educational Sciences believes.

“It’s important that pupils and students learn to actively use AI for learning, while also learning to study with it and use it adaptably in their studies on their own and with others.”

Putting your head in the sand does not help now that AI is part of our daily lives already in so many ways.

“This is why banning AI use in schools is a non-starter. On the contrary, pupils and students must be made to use it more appropriately,” Toom emphasises.

For the time being, the situation is different: it can depend on the municipality, educational institution and even the teacher whether children and adolescents use AI in learning.

The problem is precisely that today’s schools do not necessarily teach them AI skills with sufficient goal orientation.

“This is exactly where change is needed,” Toom says.
snippet: The gloomiest visions for AI depict the total annihilation of education and learning.

title: Kohuttu Pietarsaaren nikotiinipussitehdas lopettaa – edes RKP:n vetoapu ei auttanut
content:
Nikotiinipussitehdas Strengbergs Habit Factory lopettaa tuotantonsa Pietarsaaressa, kertoo Österbottens Tidning. Lehden lähteiden mukaan tuotanto jatkuu Ruotsissa.

Österbottens Tidningin mukaan tehtaan toimintaa vaikeutti se, että Suomen tupakkatuotelainsäädäntö on koko ajan tiukentunut.

TEHDAS nousi kohuaiheeksi vuonna 2024. Tuolloin nykyinen hallitus linjasi sallivansa nikotiinipusseille tietyt erikoiset maut, jotka sattumalta vastasivat Strengbergs Habit Factoryn tuotteiden makuja.

Oikeuskansleri arvioi myöhemmin, että RKP:n silloinen opetusministeri, Pietarsaaresta kotoisin ollut Anna-Maja Henriksson vaaransi asiassa lainvalmistelun asianmukaisuuden.

Hän ja hänen avustajansa olivat lain valmisteluaikana tienneet, mitä tehdas valmistaa ja mitkä maut heidän tuotantolinjoilleen sopisivat.

Kohun jälkeen hallitus ruuvasi lakeja uudestaan ja poisti huomiota herättäneet ”ruotsalaismaut” sallittujen listoilta. Ilmeisesti Pietarsaaren tehtaan oletetut kilpailuedutkin katosivat valikoiman kaventuessa.

title: Recording History Across the Four Sultanates of Moloku Kie Raha – The WikiRempah Journey: Ternate Part
content:
The Spice Route of the Indonesian archipelago is more than just an entry in history books; it is a cultural heritage whose traces can still be followed today. Born from the realization of the importance of documenting these historic sites, the WikiRempah Project focuses on recording Spice Route cultural sites—particularly in Eastern Indonesia, a region rich in history yet lacking in documentation.

For this leg of the journey, the WikiRempah team traveled across North Maluku, specifically visiting the four great sultanates known collectively as Moloku Kie Raha. Our route began in Ternate, continued to Tidore and Jailolo, and concluded in Bacan.

title: January 2026 Protests: Alireza Sepahi Executed
content:
According to HRANA, Alireza Sepahi has been executed.

Shahrzad Shahbazi, an attorney, announced in a post that at dawn today, Monday, October 5, the death sentence of Alireza Sepahi, one of those arrested during the January 2026 protests and a defendant in the case known as the “Isfahan Alikhani Square” case, was carried out at Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan.

Yesterday, HRANA reported that Mr. Sepahi had been transferred to solitary confinement and that his family had been summoned for a final visit with him.

It is also worth noting that yesterday, attorney Amirsalar Davoudi announced the marriage of the two prisoners by posting an audio recording of the marriage ceremony of Alireza Sepahi and Mahshad Kashani on his page.

HRANA had previously reported that after the Supreme Court approved a retrial in Alireza Sepahi’s case, his case was referred for reconsideration to a parallel branch of Branch 2 of the Isfahan Revolutionary Court. However, that branch rejected the retrial request without holding a hearing and sent the case to the Enforcement of Judgments Branch for implementation of the death sentence.

title: Åbos höstlov bjuder på upplevelser varje dag
content:
Åbo erbjuder ett mångsidigt program för barn och unga under höstlovet den 12–18 oktober. På programmet finns museivisningar, höstpyssel och boktips, föreställningar och rörelseglädje för såväl de yngsta familjemedlemmarna som äldre höstlovsfirare.

Under höstlovet fylls Åbo slott av tusentals berättelser. På Riddarturerna får deltagarna ge sig ut på skattjakt, medan lite äldre våghalsar kan ta del av spännande historier under Skräckrundan för barn (F-11).

På Apoteksmuseet och gården Qwensel får besökarna bekanta sig med societetens liv för tvåhundra år sedan, och i Klosterbackens gränder får besökarna höra berättelser om områdets mörka förflutna. Under Skördedagarna i Kurala Bybacke väntar höstlekar och vardagssysslor både inomhus och utomhus, och lägerelden brinner för besökare som vill grilla medhavd korv.

På barnkulturcentret Färi råder pumpahöstfeststämning tisdag–fredag den 13–16 oktober. Här kan barn skapa pumpamasker och små pumpadockor, förundras över en utställning med jättelika grönsaker och på fredagen inspireras till dans- och sånglekar av de mystiska kekrifigurerna i föreställningen Pikkukekri.

title: Internet Watch Foundation reports huge rise in AI child sexual abuse material
content:
Abuse material monitor says number of AI images assessed this year is already 40% higher than last year’s total

AI-generated child sexual abuse material is proliferating online, with the amount of illegal material investigated this year already exceeding the total for 2025.

Analysts at the Internet Watch Foundation have found more photorealistic child sexual abuse material in the first half of 2026 than for the whole of the prior year. The UK-based IWF, which monitors abuse material globally, said it had assessed 6,310 AI images that met the legal definition of child sexual abuse, 40% higher than last year’s total of more than 4,500.

title: Russia is using Ukraine’s children to win its occupation – and the wider war
content:
A year or so after the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the city of Murmansk in Russia’s Arctic north-west marked its annual regional day with a celebration for children. Alongside the sons and daughters of Russian soldiers stood children taken from the occupied Prymorskyi district of Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia region.

Ukraine’s authorities have verified 20,651 cases of children deported or forcibly displaced to Russia and Belarus since 2022. Some estimates, including figures shared by Russian officials themselves, run as high as 744,000. As of September 2026, just 2,644 Ukrainian children have been returned.

The International Criminal Court issued arrest warrants for the Russian leader, Vladimir Putin, and his children’s commissioner, Maria Lvova-Belova, in March 2023 for their roles in this campaign.

But the Where Are Our People? project, which I work alongside, has identified at least 47 Russian and Belarusian individuals directly involved in the deportations. These people range from regional governors to business executives. Only some of them are under western sanctions.

title: Pre-COP31: World leaders must show up for the Pacific through action, not just speeches
content:
• Australia must turn its claim to Pacific climate leadership into concrete action
  • Governments urged to end fossil fuel era and deliver scaled up grants-based climate finance
  • Amnesty International launches campaign spotlighting environmental human rights defenders

    • As Pacific leaders, communities and civil society gather in Fiji and Tuvalu for the Pre-COP31 meetings, the expected absence of many world leaders must not become another excuse for climate inaction, Amnesty International said today.

    The meetings come after an unusually hot European summer, with August 2026 becoming the joint-hottest month on record. Against the looming threat of a powerful El Niño, widespread wildfires, droughts, and floods, the new UN warning of the world rapidly breaching warming thresholds adds urgency to the need for decisive climate action.

    “World leaders have spent years talking about the climate threats facing the Pacific. Now they must come to Fiji and Tuvalu, listen to Pacific communities and act. Rising seas are already eating away at people’s lands, livelihoods and cultures. Concern without action will not hold back the tide,” said Agnès Callamard, Amnesty International’s Secretary General.

title: Activating the Setswana Language for Wikipedia 25: Digital Milestones and Community Growth in Botswana
content:
WIKIPEDIA 25: SETSWANA KNOWLAGE ACTIVATION

As the global Wikimedia movement aligns to celebrate Wikipedia 25, regional affiliates and user groups are critically evaluating the strategic frameworks required to build sustainable digital footprints for underrepresented languages. In Botswana, this milestone was marked by the execution of the Wikipedia 25: Setswana Knowledge Activation Campaign. Organized by WikiVerse Botswana, the initiative aimed to address systemic biases in the open-knowledge ecosystem by accelerating content depth and structural quality on the Setswana Wikipedia (tn.wikipedia.org).

Rather than evaluating success through raw data alone, this report focuses on the core qualitative breakthroughs, operational frameworks, and critical structural learnings derived from the activation. These insights establish a scalable blueprint for regional language preservation and community governance.

title: Sam Altman to Decoded: ‘The world should accept some bad things happening’ for the benefits of AI
content:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said there remains a fundamental difference in worldview between his company and rival Anthropic on artificial intelligence regulation, arguing in an exclusive interview with Decoded by POLITICO that the technology’s benefits justify accepting some risks — and that AI should remain broadly accessible to the public.

“I think there’s a lot of daylight,” Altman told Decoded co-author and POLITICO senior tech reporter Brendan Bordelon. Asked specifically where he diverges from Anthropic and its CEO Dario Amodei, Altman said, “we believe that the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology and people having the agency.”

Anthropic has long been viewed as the strongest proponent of AI regulations within the industry, a stance that until recently was at odds with the lighter-touch approach favored by OpenAI. But the policy differences between the two leading AI firms have narrowed in recent months, with OpenAI backing tougher rules as it grapples with high-profile hacking incidents and rogue behavior by its models.

title: Apply For Scholarship Now: Shape the Future of ESEAP at the ESEAP Strategy Summit 2027!
content:
The Wikimedia East, Southeast Asia, and the Pacific (ESEAP) region, in collaboration with the Wikimedians of Japan User Group (WJPUG) and the ESEAP Hub, is delighted to announce that applications for the ESEAP Strategy Summit 2027 are now open!

The Wikimedia ESEAP Strategy Summit is a three-day meeting for Wikimedians in the ESEAP region to discuss the Movement Strategy and the ongoing evolution of the ESEAP Hub. The 2027 summit, which was the first one since the ESEAP hub was formally established, is aimed to foster new leaders within region and a strategic space to discuss future support for ESEAP related and based volunteers

The Summit is expected to meet the following objectives:

  • Bringing together ESEAP leaders to accelerate ESEAP contribution to Wikimedia Movement.
  • Transitioning from governance design to practical operationalisation and capacity building to support content development in various Wikiprojects by the affiliates.
  • Supporting the inclusion of emerging communities, language diversity, and easier access for newcomers such as presence in ESEAP and global movement.
  • Strengthening peer-to-peer mentorship and collaborative projects in ESEAP.

title: The AI industry is booming. Women are getting left behind
content:
Women hold just a fraction of new AI jobs but are overrepresented in roles with high risk of AI disruption

There’s a common fear among people who work in Silicon Valley: snag one of the fast-growing, high-paying jobs in artificial intelligence, or get trapped in the “permanent underclass”, a phrase describing the fate of those who won’t have upward mobility in the age of AI.

title: Day Two at the Language Diversity Conference 2026: From Language and AI to Community Action
content:
The second day of the Language Diversity Conference 2026 continued today, Saturday, 3 October, in Accra with another full program of discussions, workshops, and practical sessions focused on the future of languages in the digital world.

It’s the first Saturday of the month, which in Ghana means national clean-up day: shops close, and people spend the morning tidying up their neighbourhoods. If the Ghanaians in the room had been at home, they’d have been out cleaning too.

There was a quick word about the food, too. So far we’d been served peppers in red, green, and black, the colours of the Ghanaian flag. The yellow ones? Still to come. Different shapes and different colours, a bit like everyone in the room.

Then it was down to business and to a question that has been hanging over this conference since day one: what does AI mean for the languages people here are working so hard to keep alive?

title: Our Solar System Is Terminally Unstable and Will Be Completely Destroyed, Study Finds
content:
Welcome back to the Abstract! These are the studies this week that searched for the ur-animals, wandered the poles, rained on Mars, and destroyed the solar system.

First, scientists present new evidence that the first animals appeared more than 800 million years ago, a truly ancient origin that suggests our metazoan ancestors survived a period known as Snowball Earth, when our planet is thought to have been nearly completely frozen. Then: Earth’s poles won’t sit still, the sepulchral stuff of life, and a dramatically shortened lifespan for our solar neighborhood.

As always, for more of my work, check out my book First Contact: The Story of Our Obsession with Aliens, or subscribe to my personal newsletter The BeX Files. 

Durbin, Orin Lole et al. “Re-evaluating molecular clock maximum age calibrations revives pre-Ediacaran divergence estimates for animals.” Science Advances.

When did the first animals emerge on Earth? It’s a question that has provoked centuries of scholarly debate, and also inspired some wonderful answers in myth and legend (I’m partial to the Bible’s tidy solution: day six checklist).

title: Satakunnan demarien piirikokous: ”Muutos nykymenoon on välttämätön – SDP tarvitsee reilun vaalivoiton”
content:
Satakunnan demarien piirikokous pidettiin lauantaina 3. lokakuuta Ulvilan Vanhakylän Työväentalolla.

Piirin puheenjohtajana jatkaa Heidi Viljanen Kankaanpäästä. Poliittisessa katsauksessa puoluesihteeri Mikkel Näkkäläjärvi arvosteli voimakkaasti kokoomuksen esittämää leikkauslistaa.

Näkkäläjärvi oli huolissaan siitä, että maailman kirjat ovat sekaisin ja näkymät ovat sumuiset. Sodat Ukrainassa ja Lähi-idässä näkyvät myös suomalaisten arjessa.

Isoin asia meillä on, että hoidamme oman pesämme kuntoon. Valitettavasti se merkitsee sitä, että puolustusmäärärahoihin on panostettavaa. Ulkopolitiikkaa on myös hoidettava kunnolla ja linjakkaasti.

– Suomen kannalta on kestämätöntä, että hallituksen sisällä vedetään aivan eri linjoja. Suomen viestin pitäisi olla yksi ja selkeä, Näkkäläjärvi totesi.

title: Global GLAM Calls: A Community Space for Cultural Heritage and Wikimedia
content:
The Wikimedia Movement depends on its relationships with cultural heritage institutions around the world, and the GLAM (Galleries, Libraries, Archives, and Museums) community is at the heart of that story. Whether they’re hosting editathons or providing primary reference material for Wikipedia content, these organizations share our mission and values, and they make it possible to expand free knowledge everywhere.

Since 2024, the GLAM community has been getting together for regular online meetups to swap ideas, talk through projects, and share success stories from this work. It’s a chance to learn from each other and to celebrate what’s happening in libraries, museums, and archives across the movement.

This year, the calls had a new helping hand: the Content Partnerships Hub, a consortium project of nine Wikimedia affiliates dedicated to supporting everyone in the movement who works with content partners. Their involvement means more outreach to the community to build agendas that reflect what people actually want to discuss, plus a structured foundation that helps the calls keep growing.

title: January 2026 Protests: Siavash Jamshidi Kheirabadi Executed
content:
According to HRANA, citing Mizan, Siavash Jamshidi Kheirabadi, son of Khodamorad, was executed.

The Judiciary’s Media Center announced today, October 3, that this citizen allegedly opened fire on security forces using a firearm on January 8, 2026, during protests on Naser Khosrow Street in Shahrekord. He was arrested two days later, and several additional firearms were reportedly discovered in his possession.

According to the institution’s claims, Mr. Jamshidi Kheirabadi also used social media during the January’s protests to “organize and carry out actions against national security.”

The report further alleged that Siavash Jamshidi Kheirabadi had prior criminal records and judicial cases, including one involving possession of an unauthorized firearm.

Ultimately, Mr. Jamshidi Kheirabadi was sentenced to death on charges of “moharebeh through drawing and firing a firearm” and “assembly and collusion against national security.” The sentence was carried out after being upheld by the Supreme Court.

The report did not specify the date or location where his execution was carried out.

title: Greece: Rights Defenders on Trial
content:
(Athens, October 3, 2026) – The ongoing prosecution of two prominent human rights defenders in Greece is a politically-motivated attempt to silence their efforts to expose abuses against migrants, Human Rights Watch said today. The trial of the two activists, Panayote Dimitras and Tommy Olsen, is set to begin on the Greek island of Rhodes on October 6, 2026.

“The upcoming trial of Panayote Dimitras and Tommy Olsen is a blatant attempt to criminalize and silence their legitimate human rights work,” said Eva Cossé, senior Europe researcher at Human Rights Watch. “Prosecutors should drop this politically motivated case against Dimitras and Olsen once and for all.”

Dimitras, founder and president of the Greek nongovernmental group Greek Helsinki Monitor, and Olsen, a Norwegian national and founder of the nongovernmental group Aegean Boat Report, are being prosecuted alongside two Cameroonian asylum seekers on charges of “forming or joining for profit and by profession a criminal organization with the purpose of facilitating the entry and stay of third country nationals into Greek territory.” If convicted, they face up to 20 years in prison.

title: Choosing the UN Chief: The Deals Behind Closed Doors
content:
A study of eight decades of bargaining over senior UN posts raises questions about the independence of António Guterres’s successor.

By Ramesh Jaura

BERLIN | 3 October 2026 (IDN) — The contest to succeed António Guterres as United Nations Secretary-General is gathering pace. Much of the public discussion centres on the candidates, their qualifications and the long-overdue prospect of a woman leading the organisation.

A less visible contest is taking place behind the scenes. Governments—particularly the five permanent members of the Security Council—may be seeking assurances about policies, reforms and senior appointments before deciding whom to support.

A study published by the civil-society campaign 1 for 8 Billion, with the Brazilian research institute Plataforma CIPÓ, examines how such bargaining has influenced the selection of UN leaders since the organisation was founded.

The 41-page report, Backroom Deals: The Trade in Promises for Support between Member States and Candidates for UN Secretary-General, identifies more than a dozen credibly alleged attempts to exchange political support for influence over senior UN appointments.

title: From pilot to policy: what Europe’s new culture declaration means for museum health and well-being
content:
In June 2026, the EU’s three main institutions put culture’s benefits for health and wellbeing into a shared political commitment for the first time. For museums running wellbeing programmes, it marks the moment the work moved from pilot projects into policy.

For more than a decade, museum health and wellbeing work has grown from the ground up. A dementia programme here, a social prescribing pilot there, a slow-looking session for NHS staff somewhere else. The evidence has built steadily, but the work has often depended on a passionate team, a short-term grant and a sympathetic director.

2026 looks different. On 18 June, the European Parliament, the European Commission and the Council of the EU signed a joint declaration called Europe for Culture – Culture for Europe. Among its commitments is a pledge to promote the positive effects of culture on health and wellbeing.

title: Watch: We Uncovered Bribery Allegations Involving Susan Collins
content:
In late 2024, FBI investigators had enough evidence to launch a sweeping bribery probe that could ensnare top lawmakers, including Sen. Susan Collins. The agency was examining interactions between Collins and a top donor: Martin Kao, CEO of defense contractor Navatek.

According to Kao, in 2019, the head of the pro-Collins super PAC met with him and other Navatek execs and asked for a $500,000 donation. Government contractors are banned from making political contributions. For the company to offer donations to Collins in exchange for an official action, or for Collins to accept, would constitute criminal bribery.

To skirt campaign finance laws and conceal the source of the funds, Kao sent an initial $150,000 to the super PAC using a shell company, saying he had cleared it with his lawyer. The head of the super PAC knew Kao was behind the donation. “Very smart,” he replied in an email viewed by ProPublica.

Weeks later, Kao told his team Collins committed to getting the company $32 million in naval contracts.
